strings.basemap.googleKey.title: Maɓallin API na Google Maps
strings.basemap.googleKey.explain: Taswirorin Google suna zuwa daga Map Tiles API na Google Maps Platform da maɓallinka: ana ƙidaya amfani (kuma ana caji bayan kason kyauta) a asusunka na Google Cloud.
strings.basemap.googleKey.steps: 1. A cikin Google Cloud Console ƙirƙiri aiki ka kunna "Map Tiles API".   2. A ƙarƙashin Credentials ƙirƙiri maɓallin API.   3. Taƙaita maɓallin ga shafukan (HTTP referrers) da ka ke amfani da app.
strings.basemap.googleKey.privacy: Ana ajiye maɓallin a ma'ajiyar wannan mai binciken gizo, wadda kowane rubutun shirin (script) na wannan shafin zai iya karantawa, har da na ƙididdigar ziyara (Google Analytics), kuma ana aika shi ga Google kaɗai. Ka takaita maɓallin ga wannan shafin a Google Cloud console.

strings.adv.no_supply.why: Lissafi yana farawa daga tushen ruwa (rijiya, tafki, famfon gwamnati ko magudanar ruwa) mai sanannen matakin ruwa da matsi. Ba tare da shi ba ruwa ba shi da inda zai fito, kuma ba za a iya lissafa komai ba.
strings.adv.no_supply.how: Zaɓi kayan aikin Tushen ruwa (WS) ka danna ƙarshen babban bututu inda ruwa ke shiga. Duba “Lissafa matsin da ake buƙata” idan har yanzu ba ka san matsin da ke akwai ba: shirin zai faɗi nawa ake buƙata.
strings.adv.no_valves.why: Kowane yanki (bututun lateral da ke ban ruwa tare) yana buƙatar bawul na sarrafawa da ke haɗa shi da babban bututu. A bawul ne shirin ke raba yankuna ya lissafa matsin kowanne.
strings.adv.no_valves.how: Sa Bawul na sarrafawa (V) inda babban bututu ya haɗu da farkon yanki. Kayan aikin Rukunin lateral (B) yana zana lateral, bututun rarrabawa da bawul a lokaci ɗaya.
strings.adv.no_hydraulics.why: Zanen bai da bututu, masu fitar da ruwa ko bawuloli tukuna: sai an zana hanyar ban ruwa ne akwai abin lissafi.
strings.adv.no_hydraulics.how: Fara daga misali (Fayil → Misalai) ko Koyarwa mai mu'amala (Taimako). Don sabuwar ƙira: zana fili, ƙirƙiri Rukunin lateral (B), haɗa bawuloli da babban bututu, sannan ka sa tushen ruwa.
strings.adv.unconnected.why: Abubuwan da suka taɓa juna daidai (cikin juriyar haɗi) ne kawai aka haɗa. Abu a wajen hanyar ruwa ba ya samun ruwa kuma ba a lissafa shi; yawanci an ajiye shi santimita kaɗan daga bututu.
strings.adv.unconnected.how: Danna “Nuna a zanen” ka ja abin zuwa bututu yayin da Kamawa ke kunne, ko ka yi amfani da gyara da ke kai shi zuwa bututu ko abu mai dacewa mafi kusa.
strings.adv.zero_length.why: Bututu marar tsawo (maki biyu a wuri ɗaya) ba ya ɗaukar ruwa kuma yana ɓata ginin hanyar ruwa. Yawanci yana fitowa daga danna sau biyu bisa kuskure.
strings.adv.zero_length.how: Share bututun; babu abin da zai ɓace.
strings.adv.tiny_segment.why: Kusurwoyi biyu da suka fi kusa da juriyar haɗi suna zama kulli ɗaya; ƙaramin yanki tsakaninsu na iya haɗa abubuwan da bai kamata su taɓa ba.
strings.adv.tiny_segment.how: Cire kusurwoyin da aka maimaita (gyara yana yin haka ba tare da canza hanya ba).
strings.adv.duplicate_item.why: Abubuwa biyu iri ɗaya a wuri ɗaya (misali an manna sau biyu) suna ninka kwarara da kuɗi a jerin kayayyaki.
strings.adv.duplicate_zone_name.why: Rahotanni, zanguna da jadawali suna gane yankuna ta suna; sunaye iri ɗaya suna sa sakamako ya zama marar tabbas.
strings.adv.duplicate_zone_name.how: Ba kowane yanki suna daban a halayen bawul, ko ka bar gyara ya ba su lambobi.
strings.adv.pipes_cross.why: Bututun da suka ratsa juna ba tare da kusurwa ta tarayya ba ba a haɗa su ba, kamar a gona inda ɗaya ke wucewa saman ɗayan. Idan ya kamata a haɗa su, kullin ba ya nan.
strings.adv.pipes_cross.how: Idan haɗi ne (T ko giciye), yi amfani da “Haɗa bututun a mahaɗa”. Idan ɗaya kawai yana wucewa saman ɗayan, daidai ne kuma za a iya watsi da gargaɗin.
strings.adv.mainline_dead_end.why: Ƙarshen babban bututu ɗaya bai kai ga kowane bawul, tushe ko mai fitar da ruwa ba: bututun yana ƙarewa a sarari. Ba ya kai ruwa ko'ina amma yana ƙara kuɗi.
strings.adv.mainline_dead_end.how: Haɗa ƙarshen da bawul ko tushen da ya kamata ya kai, ko share ragowar yanki. Idan ƙirar ba ta da tushe tukuna, yawanci wurinsa ne wannan ƙarshen.
strings.adv.zone_dead_end.why: Bututun yanki yana ƙarewa ba tare da lateral ko mai fitar da ruwa a ƙarshensa ba. Wani lokaci da gangan ne (wurin wanke bututu), wani lokaci yanki ne da aka manta.
strings.adv.zone_dead_end.how: Idan ba shi da amfani, gajarta shi ko share shi don adana bututu.
strings.adv.zone_no_emitters.why: Bawul ɗin ba ya ciyar da kowane mai fitar da ruwa: ba tare da kwarara ba babu abin aunawa, kuma yankin ya kasance babu komai a sakamako.
strings.adv.zone_no_emitters.how: Tabbatar bututu da lateral na yankin sun taɓa bawul (fitar bawul = farkon bututun rarrabawa). Yi amfani da “Nuna a zanen” ka haɗa su, ko share bawul idan yankin ba ya nan.
strings.adv.area_no_emitters.why: An zana filin ban ruwa amma babu masu fitar da ruwa a ciki; yana shiga lissafin daidaiton ruwa ba tare da an ba shi ruwa ba.
strings.adv.area_no_emitters.how: Ƙirƙiri Rukunin lateral (B) ko Grid na masu fesa ruwa a cikin filin, ko share filin idan misali ne kawai.
strings.adv.spec_missing.why: Abin yana nuni ga samfurin da ba ya cikin kasidar aikin (an share shi ko ya zo daga wani fayil). Ba tare da lanƙwasar samfurin ba ba za a iya lissafi ba.
strings.adv.spec_missing.how: Zaɓi samfuri a halayen abin, ko yi amfani da gyara da ke sa samfurin kasida (ga bututu, lissafi ne zai zaɓi faɗin).
strings.adv.supply_no_head.why: Tushen yana da ƙayyadadden matsi na sifili: kamar tanki a matakin ƙasa ba tare da famfo ba. Kusan ba a taɓa son haka ba, kuma duk bawuloli za su rasa matsi.
strings.adv.supply_no_head.how: Shigar da ainihin matsin tushe (famfon gwamnati, misali mita 25 na ruwa) ko duba “Lissafa matsin da ake buƙata” don shirin ya faɗi nawa ake buƙata.
strings.adv.looped_mainline.why: Babban bututu yana yin zobe. Mai warware hanyar ruwa yana lissafin zobba daidai; auna girma ta shirin layi yana amfani da hanyoyin bishiya kuma ana maimaita shi da kwararar da aka sake rarrabawa har sai ya daidaita, kuma nazarin ƙarshe yana duba matsi.
strings.adv.looped_mainline.how: Babu abin yi idan zoben da gangan ne (yana rarraba matsi da kyau). Idan ba haka ba, cire yankin da ke rufe zoben.
strings.adv.no_terrain.why: Ba tare da layukan tsayi ko maki na tsayi ba, ana ɗaukar ƙasa a matsayin fili. A ƙasa mai gangare, hawa da gangara suna canza matsin masu fitar da ruwa sosai.
strings.adv.no_terrain.how: Sauke tsayin ƙasa daga intanet (Ƙira → Ƙasa), shigo da GeoTIFF ko DXF mai layukan tsayi, ko rubuta wasu maki na tsayi. A ƙasa mai fili na gaske, za ka iya watsi da shi.
strings.adv.not_converged.why: Lissafin haidiroliki bai kai ga mafita mai tsayayye ba, yawanci saboda bayanai masu tsanani: ƙaramin bututu mai babbar kwarara, famfo nesa da iyakarsa, ko ƙimomin sifili.
strings.adv.not_converged.how: Da farko warware sauran kurakuran jerin (musamman abubuwan da ba a haɗa ba da samfuran da suka ɓace) sannan ka sake lissafi. Nemi faɗi da matsi marasa ma'ana a halaye.
strings.adv.cannot_meet_pressure_window.why: Masu fitar da ruwa na yankin dole su yi aiki cikin kewayon matsi (taga). Ko da mafi girman bututun da aka yarda, asarar gogayya ko gangare suna barin wasu a waje: yankin ya yi tsawo ko gangare sosai, ko matsin da aka nema yana wajen iyakar bututun fesawa.
strings.adv.cannot_meet_pressure_window.how: Gwada bisa wannan tsari: bari lissafi ya zaɓi faɗi; raba yankin zuwa bawuloli biyu; ciyar da lateral daga tsakiya; yi amfani da masu fitar da ruwa masu daidaita matsi; kunna manyan bututu a kasida.
strings.adv.outlet_over_pressure.why: Wani mai fitar da ruwa yana samun matsi fiye da abin da bututun fesawa zai iya jurewa, abu ne na yau da kullum a yankunan gangara inda kowace mita ta gangara ke ƙara matsi. Yana ƙara kwarara, girman ɗigo da lalacewa.
strings.adv.outlet_over_pressure.how: Raba yankin bisa matakan tsayi, yi amfani da masu fitar da ruwa masu daidaita matsi ko masu daidaita matsi a lateral, ko rage matsi a bawul.
strings.adv.velocity_exceeded.why: Ruwa yana gudu da sauri sosai a wannan bututu (sama da iyakar sigogi, yawanci 1.5–2 m/s). Gudu mai yawa yana ɓata matsi, yana ƙara bugun ruwa kuma yana lalata bututu.
strings.adv.velocity_exceeded.how: Bari lissafi ya zaɓi faɗi (idan ka ƙayyade shi) ko yi amfani da babban bututu. Idan shi ne mafi girma a kasida, raba kwarara: ƙarin zanguna ko wani layi.
strings.adv.pressure_rating_exceeded.why: Matsin aiki ya wuce ajin (PN) bututun, wanda zai iya fashewa. Yana faruwa kusa da famfuna masu ƙarfi ko a mafi ƙasƙancin wurin ƙasa.
strings.adv.pressure_rating_exceeded.how: Yi amfani da bututu mai babban aji mai faɗi iri ɗaya (gyara yana zaɓar mafi arha da ke jurewa), ko rage matsi: ƙaramin famfo ko bawul mai rage matsi.
strings.adv.surge_rating_exceeded.why: Idan aka rufe bawul da sauri, ruwan da ke gudana yana tsayawa kwatsam ya haifar da hauhawar matsi (bugun ruwa). Tare da matsi na yau da kullum, yana wuce ajin bututu.
strings.adv.surge_rating_exceeded.how: Yi amfani da bututu mai babban aji, rufe bawuloli a hankali (lokacin rufewa a sigogi) ko rage gudu da bututu mai faɗi.
strings.adv.valve_flow_out_of_range.why: Kwararar yankin tana wajen kewayon bawul da aka zaɓa: ƙarami sosai yana rasa matsi da yawa; babba sosai ba ya daidaita da kyau.
strings.adv.valve_flow_out_of_range.how: Sa bawul mai girma daidai (gyara yana zaɓar mafi ƙanƙanta da ya dace).
strings.adv.valve_pressure_deficit.why: Matsin da ke isowa bawul ya yi ƙasa da abin da yankin ke buƙata: tushen ba shi da matsin shawo kan asara a babban bututu da hawa zuwa yankin.
strings.adv.valve_pressure_deficit.how: Sa ko canza famfo (gyara yana zaɓar ɗaya don kwarara da matsi), yi amfani da manyan bututu a babban bututu ko raba zanguna. Idan matsin tushe hasashe ne kawai, bari shirin ya lissafa shi.
strings.adv.pivot_pressure_deficit.why: Pivot yana buƙatar matsin shiga don mai fesa ruwa na ƙarshe ya yi aiki; babban bututu yana bayar da ƙasa da haka.
strings.adv.pivot_pressure_deficit.how: Zaɓi famfo mai dacewa, ƙara faɗin bututun jigila ko duba matsin ƙarshe da aka nema a halayen pivot.
strings.adv.supply_flow_exceeded.why: Zangon yana neman kwarara fiye da abin da tushe ke bayarwa (kwararar ƙirarsa). A aikace ruwa zai ƙare kuma matsi zai faɗi.
strings.adv.supply_flow_exceeded.how: Raba yankuna zuwa ƙarin zanguna (gyara yana sake tara su yadda babu wanda zai wuce kwararar tushe), ko ƙara kwararar tushe idan da gaske ya yarda.
strings.adv.supply_head_exceeded.why: Don hidimar duk bawuloli, tushe zai buƙaci matsi fiye da matsakaicin da aka shigar masa.
strings.adv.supply_head_exceeded.how: Sa famfo mai ƙarfafa matsi (booster) bayan tushe, yi amfani da manyan bututu ko raba zanguna don rage asarar gogayya.
strings.adv.pump_out_of_range.why: Famfon yana aiki a wajen kewayon kwararar lanƙwasarsa: ƙarami sosai, ba ya iya bayar da kwarara; babba sosai, yana aiki kusa da rufewa kuma yana ɓata makamashi.
strings.adv.pump_out_of_range.how: Zaɓi famfo mai dacewa: gyara yana kwatanta famfunan kasida ya ɗauki wanda kuɗin sayensa + makamashi ya fi ƙaranci kuma yana hidimar duk zanguna.
strings.adv.pump_suction_lift.why: Famfon saman ƙasa yana tsotsar ruwa ta hanyar gurɓataccen iska (vacuum), kuma matsin sararin sama yana tura ruwa sama kusan mita 10 kawai; a aikace, tare da asara da NPSH, iyakar kusan mita 7 ce a matakin teku (ƙasa da haka a tuddai). Fiye da haka famfo yana yin kafewa ko ya rasa ruwan farawa.
strings.adv.pump_suction_lift.how: Yi amfani da famfon nutsewa a cikin rijiya, ko ka sa famfon saman ƙasa kusa da matakin ruwa. Matsi mara kyau a mashigar famfo shi ne wannan tsayin tsotsa.
strings.adv.zone_overlap.why: An haɗa yankuna biyu da bututu ba tare da bawul a tsakaninsu ba: ruwan ɗaya yana shiga ɗayan kuma shirin ba zai iya raba su ba.
strings.adv.zone_overlap.how: Yanke bututun da ke haɗa yankunan (kayan aikin Yanke bututu). Idan a gaskiya yanki ɗaya ne, share ɗaya daga cikin bawulolin.
strings.adv.lp_infeasible.why: Da bututun da aka kunna a kasida, babu haɗin da ke cika duk matsi a lokaci guda; shirin ya yi amfani da hanyar kwaɗayi (ƙara girma mataki-mataki), wadda ke ba da sakamako mai kyau amma watakila ba mafi arha ba.
strings.adv.lp_infeasible.how: Kunna manyan faɗi a kasida, ƙara adadin faɗi a kowane layi a sigogi ko rage buƙatar matsi (ƙananan yankuna).
strings.adv.fitting_missing.why: Jerin kayayyaki yana buƙatar haɗe (soket, gwiwa, T…) mai girman da kasida ba ta da shi; yana kasancewa ba shi da farashi.
strings.adv.fitting_missing.how: Ƙara haɗe-haɗe na gama-gari a kasida (gyara) ko shigar da na mai kawo maka a Kasidar kayan aiki.
strings.adv.pivot_no_flow.why: Pivot yana da zurfin ruwa ko awanni a kowane zagaye na sifili, don haka kwararar da aka lissafa sifili ce.
strings.adv.pivot_no_flow.how: Shigar da zurfin ruwa a kowane zagaye (mm) da awanni a kowane zagaye a halayen pivot.
strings.adv.pivot_no_end_pressure.why: Ba tare da matsin ƙarshe (mai fesa ruwa na ƙarshe) ba ba za a iya lissafa matsin shigar pivot ba.
strings.adv.pivot_no_end_pressure.how: Shigar da matsin ƙarshe a halayen pivot (yawanci mita 10–20 na ruwa tare da masu daidaitawa).
strings.adv.pivot_app_rate.why: A ƙarshe, pivot yana zuba ruwa da sauri fiye da yadda ƙasa za ta iya sha: ruwa yana gudana ya haifar da zaizayar ƙasa.
strings.adv.pivot_app_rate.how: Yi amfani da masu fesa ruwa masu faɗin jiƙawa mafi girma a ƙarshe, ƙara saurin juyawa (ƙarancin zurfin ruwa a kowane zagaye) ko duba iyakar ƙasa.
strings.adv.valve_missing.why: Wani zango yana nuni ga bawul da ba ya nan kuma (an share shi).
strings.adv.valve_missing.how: Tsaftace zanguna (gyara) ko buɗe Ƙira → Zangon aiki ka cire bawul daga zangon.
strings.adv.set_velocity.why: Iyakokin gudu a sigogi suna wajen kewayon zahiri (0.3–5 m/s). Sifili ko ƙimomi masu yawa suna sa auna girma ya zama ba zai yiwu ba ko marar ma'ana.
strings.adv.set_velocity.how: Maido da na tsoho (1.5 m/s a yankuna, 2 m/s a lateral da babban bututu) ko daidaita su a Ƙira → Sigogin ƙira.
strings.adv.set_hours.why: Awannin aiki a shekara suna wajen 1–8760 (shekara na da awanni 8760). Kuɗin makamashi da zaɓin bututu bisa jimillar kuɗi sun dogara da su.
strings.adv.set_hours.how: Maido da na tsoho (awanni 2000 ga babban bututu, awanni 500 ga kowane yanki) ko shigar da ainihin awanni a Ƙira → Sigogin ƙira.
strings.adv.set_economy.why: Wani sigar tattalin arziki ba zai yiwu ba: riba mara kyau ko sama da 50 % a shekara, wa'adi a wajen shekaru 1–100, ingancin famfo a wajen 20–95 % ko farashin wutar lantarki mara kyau.
strings.adv.set_economy.how: Maido da na tsoho ko gyara su a Ƙira → Sigogin ƙira.
strings.adv.set_tolerance.why: Juriyar haɗi tana faɗin kusancin da maki biyu ke buƙata don a ɗauke su a haɗe. Sifili ba ya haɗa komai; manyan ƙimomi (fiye da mita 1) suna haɗa abubuwan da ya kamata su rabu.
strings.adv.set_tolerance.how: Maido da na tsoho (santimita 5) a Ƙira → Sigogin ƙira.
strings.adv.set_variation.why: Matsakaicin bambancin matsi a yanki yana wajen 0–60 %. Ma'aunin da aka saba shi ne 10–20 % (kusan ±10 % na kwarara).
strings.adv.set_variation.how: Maido da na tsoho (0 = amfani da kewayon matsin mai fitar da ruwa) ko shigar da 20 %.
strings.adv.set_temperature.why: Zafin ruwa yana wajen 0–60 °C; yana canza ɗanko da ake amfani da shi a asarar gogayya (Darcy-Weisbach).
strings.adv.no_pipes_for_usage.why: Kasidar ba ta da bututun da aka kunna don wannan amfani (lateral, yanki ko babban bututu), don haka lissafi ba shi da faɗin da zai zaɓa.
strings.adv.no_pipes_for_usage.how: Kunna bututu a Kasidar kayan aiki ko yi amfani da gyara da ke sake kunna bututun tsoho na wannan amfani.
strings.adv.supply_limits.why: A tushe, matsin ko kwararar ƙira ya fi matsakaicin da aka shigar: ɗaya daga cikin ƙimomin ya musanya ko an rubuta shi ba daidai ba.
strings.adv.supply_limits.how: Duba ƙimomin a halayen tushe; gyara yana daidaita matsakaici da ƙimar ƙira.
strings.adv.valve_not_in_flow.why: An ayyana zanguna, amma waɗannan yankuna ba sa cikin kowanne: ba sa buɗewa a kwaikwayon babban bututu kuma ba sa cikin matsi da makamashin da aka lissafa.
strings.adv.valve_not_in_flow.how: Sa yankunan a zango a Ƙira → Zangon aiki, ko yi amfani da gyara da ke ƙirƙira musu sabon zango.
strings.adv.flow_empty.why: Wasu zanguna ba su da kowane yanki (babu komai ko bawuloli da aka share kawai): ba sa yin komai kuma suna ruɗa jadawali.
strings.adv.flow_empty.how: Tsaftace zanguna (gyara) ko ƙara musu yankuna a Ƙira → Zangon aiki.
strings.adv.flow_duration.why: Zango mai tsawon lokaci sifili ko mara kyau ba ya ban ruwa kuma yana sa makamashinsa sifili.
strings.adv.flow_duration.how: Shigar da tsawon kowane zango (awanni) a Ƙira → Zangon aiki; gyara yana sa awa 1.
strings.adv.emitter_head_range.why: Matsin aikin da aka nema ga mai fitar da ruwa yana wajen iyakar bututun fesawa (mafi ƙaranci da mafi girma na kasida). Saboda haka babu bututun da zai iya riƙe yankin cikin tagar matsi: yankin ya zama ba zai yiwu ba.
strings.adv.emitter_head_range.how: Yi amfani da matsin asali na bututun fesawa (gyara) ko zaɓi wani bututun fesawa ko mai fitar da ruwa da aka yi don matsin da kake so.
strings.adv.pump_speed.why: Saurin famfo na dangantaka yana wajen 40–130 % na asali; bisa dokokin kamanceceniya, lanƙwasar ta zama abin da ainihin famfo ba zai iya yi ba.
strings.adv.pump_speed.how: Koma saurin asali (1.0) ko yi amfani da mai canza mitar wuta kawai cikin kewayon mai ƙera.

Farashi ya kasance sifili: fitar da Excel, cike da jerin farashin yankinku sannan shigo da shi. Ku tabbatar koyaushe da takardar bayanai ta yanzu.

strings.welcome.title: Barka da zuwa OpenCADIrrigation
strings.welcome.body: CAD don ƙirar ban ruwa ta matsi, kai tsaye a mai binciken gizo. Fara da misali da aka shirya ko ka bi koyarwa mai mu'amala: tana farawa da gano wurinka a taswirar tauraron ɗan adam da sauke yanayin ƙasa daga intanet, sannan ta ci gaba da gajerun matakai 80 inda kai da kanka za ka kewaya, ka zana, ka gina hanyar sadarwa kuma ka yi ƙira; kowane mataki yana gane lokacin da ka kammala shi kuma ya wuce gaba da kansa. Tana ɗaukar kusan minti 20 kuma ana iya tsallake ta a kowane lokaci (Taimako → Koyarwa mai mu'amala yana sake buɗe ta).
strings.welcome.examplesHint: Kowane aiki yana buɗewa a shirye don ƙira: danna F5 ko ▶ ka ga yankuna, matsi, girman bututu da jerin kayan aiki. Fayil → Misalai yana sake buɗe kowanne daga cikinsu.

strings.share.title: Raba aikin ta hanyar haɗi
strings.share.hint: Duk aikin yana tafiya a cikin adireshin kansa, an matse shi, a ɓangaren bayan # (wanda mai binciken gizo ba ya aikawa ga kowace sabar): duk wanda ya buɗe hanyar haɗin yana samun kwafi a sabon shafi. Ana barin hotunan bango da sakamako; mai karɓa yana sake yin ƙira.
strings.share.long: Hanyar haɗi mai tsawo: wasu manhajojin hira da imel na iya yanke ta. Ga manyan ayyuka, aika fayil ɗin .oci.json.
strings.share.tooLong: Aikin ya yi girma da yawa don hanyar haɗi. Ajiye shi ka aika fayil ɗin .oci.json.

strings.warn.pump_npsh: NPSH da ke akwai ya yi ƙasa da abin da famfo ke buƙata (haɗarin cavitation)
strings.warn.vfd_target_unreachable: Mai canza mitar wuta ba zai iya kai matsin da ake nufi ba ko a cikakken sauri
strings.warn.vfd_below_min_speed: Matsin da ake nufi yana buƙatar sauri ƙasa da mafi ƙarancin saurin mai canza mitar wuta
strings.adv.pump_npsh.why: Cikakken matsi a mashigar famfo, idan aka cire matsin tururin ruwa, ya yi ƙasa da NPSH da famfo ke buƙata a wannan kwarara: ruwa yana zama tururi a cikin impeller (cavitation), famfo yana rasa tsayi, yana hayaniya kuma yana lalacewa.
strings.adv.pump_npsh.how: Saukar da famfo kusa da matakin ruwa ko yi amfani da na nutsewa, ƙara faɗi kuma ka gajarta bututun tsotsa, ko zaɓi famfo mai ƙaramin NPSH da ake buƙata a wannan kwarara.
strings.adv.vfd_target_unreachable.why: Ko a cikakken sauri famfo ba ya bayar da matsin da mai canza mitar wuta ya kamata ya riƙe a mafitarsa da kwararar wannan zangon.
strings.adv.vfd_target_unreachable.how: Rage matsin da ake nufi, raba zangon ko zaɓi babban famfo.
strings.adv.vfd_below_min_speed.why: A wannan zangon famfo yana bayar da matsin da ake nufi ƙasa da mafi ƙarancin saurin mai canza mitar wuta; yana aiki a mafi ƙarancin sauri kuma matsin yana kasancewa sama da abin da ake nufi.
strings.adv.vfd_below_min_speed.how: Haɗa ƙarin yankuna a zangon, rage mafi ƙarancin sauri idan mai ƙera ya yarda, ko karɓi matsin da ya ɗan fi girma.

strings.props.vfdMin: Mafi ƙarancin saurin mai canza mitar wuta (kaso)

strings.adv.vfd_target_low.why: Idan mai canza mitar wuta yana riƙe wannan matsin fita, bawul mafi buƙata a zangon yana rasa matsin da yake nema; ƙirar tana nuna nawa tushe zai ƙara.
strings.adv.vfd_target_low.how: Ƙara matsin da mai canza mitar wuta ke nufi zuwa matsin da ake buƙata tare da asarar babban bututu.

strings.adv.pivot_pkg_pressure.why: Kunshin masu fesa ruwa yana lissafa, mafita bayan mafita, matsin da ke isa kowane mai daidaita matsi da bakin fesawa tare da gogayya, hawan ƙasa, tsayin bututu da bututun rataye. Mai daidaita matsi yana daidaitawa ne kawai idan yana da aƙalla 5 psi sama da ajinsa; ƙasa da haka bakunan fesawa suna samun ƙarancin matsi da kwarara.
strings.adv.pivot_pkg_pressure.how: Auna famfo da bututun isarwa don matsin shiga da kunshin ke nema (ƙirar babban bututu ta riga ta yi amfani da shi), zaɓi masu daidaita matsi masu ƙaramin aji ko duba matsin ƙarshe da tsayin bakunan fesawa a kunshin pivot.
strings.adv.pivot_pkg_nozzles.why: Kowace mafitar pivot tana buƙatar kwarara daidai da fadin wurin da take ba ruwa (Heermann and Hein). Bakin fesawa da aka zaɓa shi ne wanda kwararar sa ta fi kusa a matsin mafitar; idan jerin bakunan fesawa yana da manyan tazara ko gajere ne, ko matsin ya fita daga kewayonsa, zurfin ruwa ba ya daidaita a tsawon injin.
strings.adv.pivot_pkg_nozzles.how: Yi amfani da jerin bakunan fesawa masu lamba (ba tare da mai fesa ruwa na kasida ba) ko mai fesa ruwa mai ƙarin bakunan fesawa, faɗaɗa kewayon lambobi, ko rage tazarar mafita a ƙarshen injin.
strings.adv.pivot_pkg_setup.why: Kunshin masu fesa ruwa yana buƙatar mafita a tsawon sassan pivot, kwarara (zurfi da awanni ga zagaye) kuma, idan akwai bindigar ƙarshe, kwarara ko radius na bindigar.
strings.adv.pivot_pkg_setup.how: Duba tsawo, sassan, tazarar masu fesa ruwa, zurfi da awanni ga zagaye a kaddarorin pivot; a kunshin pivot, shigar da bindigar ƙarshe ko kashe ta.
strings.adv.pivot_pkg_no_drive.why: Teburin mai ƙidaya lokaci (awanni ga kowane juyi da zurfi a kowane saiti) yana fitowa daga saurin hasumiya ta ƙarshe a 100 %, wanda ya dogara da mota, akwatunan giya da taya.
strings.adv.pivot_pkg_no_drive.how: A kunshin pivot, shigar da saurin mota, rabon giya da diamitar taya, ko saurin hasumiya ta ƙarshe a 100 % da mai ƙera ya bayar.
strings.adv.corner_arm.why: Hannun kusurwa yana juyawa a hasumiya ta ƙarshe kuma ƙarshensa yana bin hanyar jagora (iyakar gona da aka janye ciki), yana buɗewa zuwa kusurwoyi. Bayan kaiwar hannun da aka miƙe ko aka naɗe, ƙarshen ba zai iya bin hanyar ba kuma wani ɓangare na kusurwa yana kasancewa a bushe ko ya sami ruwa sau biyu.
strings.adv.corner_arm.how: Zaɓi a matsayin jagora rufaffiyar iyaka kewaye da wurin pivot, daidaita nisan janyewa, tsawon hannu ko mafi girman kusurwar naɗewa; duba zurfi da awanni ga zagaye na pivot.
strings.adv.vri_limits.why: A ban ruwa mai ƙima mai sauyawa, zurfin kowane sashe yana fitowa daga saitin mai ƙidaya lokaci: a 100 % pivot yana zuba mafi ƙanƙantar zurfin da zai yiwu, a mafi jinkirin saiti kuma mafi girma. Ana takaita abubuwan da ake nufi da suka fita wannan kewayo.
strings.adv.vri_limits.how: Shigar da saurin hasumiya ta ƙarshe, sake duba zurfin ruwan tsarin ko mafi jinkirin saitin da allon sarrafawa ke karɓa; don zurfin da ya yi ƙasa da na 100 %, yi amfani da sarrafa yanki (rukunin masu fesa ruwa).
strings.adv.pivot_elec_drop.why: Motocin hasumiyoyi suna a ƙarshen dogon kebul: lantarkin dukansu yana wucewa ta sassan farko kuma voltage yana faɗuwa a tsawon injin, fiye da haka lokacin da mota ke farawa. Ƙasa da iyaka motocin suna yin zafi sosai ko su kasa farawa.
strings.adv.pivot_elec_drop.how: Ƙara kaurin kebul na sassan pivot ko na kebul na samar da wuta, gajarta layin samar da wuta, yi amfani da voltage mafi girma ko motoci masu ƙarancin ƙarfi.

strings.wr.title: Hanyoyin wayoyi ta atomatik
strings.wr.hint: Wayoyi suna bin ramukan bututu daga kowane mai sarrafawa zuwa bawulolinsa, manyan bawuloli da relays na kunna famfo (kowanne zuwa mai sarrafawa mafi kusa ta ramukan); ana ba tashoshi lambobi bisa nisa. Mafi gajerun hanyoyi suna ba kowace wayar tasha mafi ƙarancin tsawo; bishiyar mafi ƙarancin jimlar tsawo ta dace da tsarin wayoyi biyu. Zana yana ƙirƙirar hanyoyin a matsayin hanyoyin wayoyi na aikin, waɗanda ƙirar wayoyin bawuloli ke bi.

strings.tw.title: Tsarin wayoyi biyu (dekoda)
strings.tw.hint: Wayoyi biyu suna fita daga mai sarrafawa kuma su wuce kowane bawul; dekoda da aka haɗa a kan wayoyin biyu yana tafiyar da solenoids 1, 2, 4 ko 6 na kusa. Wayar da aka zaɓa ita ce mafi arha a jerin da ke riƙe kowane dekoda sama da mafi ƙarancin voltage yayin da tasha ke buɗewa tare da sauran na zangonta a kunne. strings.crit.title: Muhimmancin sassan babban bututu
strings.crit.hint: Kowane sashen babban bututu yana daina aiki bi da bi (yoyo, gyara) yayin da zangon da aka zaɓa ke buɗe: yankunan da ke rasa tushe, waɗanda suka rage ƙasa da matsin da suke buƙata da kuma nawa daga kwararar su warwarewa mai dogaro da matsi ke bayarwa har yanzu. A babban bututu mai rassa kowane sashe yana yanke abin da ke ƙasa da shi; zobba suna ba da wasu hanyoyi.

strings.cal.title: Daidaita ƙaushi (C na Hazen-Williams)
strings.cal.hint: Rubuta matsin da aka karanta a gona a wurare na babban bututu da kwararar da ke fita daga tushe yayin da zangon da aka zaɓa ke aiki. Lissafin yana neman ma'aunin C na kowane bututu da ya fi sake samar da karatun (mafi ƙanƙantar murabba'ai da aka auna da σ, ana warware hanyar sadarwa a kowace gwaji). Matsin da aka karanta a tushe shi ne abin da hanyar sadarwa ke karɓa: karanta shi ma. Aiwatar yana canza ma'aunin C na sigogin ƙira.

strings.bomSel.hint: Adadin abubuwan da aka zaɓa (wani sashe na aiki, oda), tare da kuɗin kasida: bututu da tef bisa mitar da aka zana; emitters, bawuloli, na'urori da famfuna bisa naúra. Ana barin mahaɗai, waɗanda na mahaɗar abubuwa ne, a waje.
strings.bomSel.empty: Babu kayan aiki a zaɓin: zaɓi bututu, emitters, bawuloli ko wasu abubuwan ruwa.
strings.bomSel.unsized: Bututun da aka zaɓa mai m {m} bai da girma tukuna: gudanar da ƙira don auna shi kuma a haɗa shi.
strings.det.n.airValve0: Sanya a wurare masu tsayi, bayan famfuna da kuma inda gangara ke canzawa.
strings.dlg.mainsHzHint: Famfuna masu tsayayyen sauri da aka auna lanƙwasarsu a wata mita suna juyawa daidai gwargwado (60 Hz a layin wuta na 50 Hz: 5/6 na sauri, 69 % na tsayin matsi)
strings.cat.ratedHz: Mitar lanƙwasa (Hz, 0 = ba a bayyana ba)
strings.msg.autosaveNoImages: Kwafin atomatik a mai binciken gizo yana barin hotunan da aka saka a cikin aikin (aikin yana da {mb} MB): ajiye aikin a fayil don a adana su.
strings.msg.autosaveTooLarge: Aikin ({mb} MB) ya yi girma da yawa ga kwafin atomatik a mai binciken gizo: ajiye shi a fayil, domin shi ne ke kare shi idan shirin ya rufe ba zato.
strings.imp.err.tiff_bigtiff: Fayil ɗin BigTIFF (sama da 4 GB ko an rubuta shi a wannan tsari): ajiye shi a matsayin TIFF na yau da kullum, ko JPEG/PNG tare da fayil ɗin world, sannan ka sake shigo da shi
strings.msg.tinThinned: Ƙasar tana da wurare {n}: TIN yana amfani da 1 cikin kowane {k} (kusan {m}) don ya ci gaba da sauri; ƙididdigar IDW, a ƙaramin menu na Ƙasa, tana amfani da su duka.
strings.warn.vih_pressure_deficit: Matsi bai isa ba a mai fesa ruwa mai bawul a ciki
strings.warn.vih_pressure_high: Matsi ya wuce taga a mai fesa ruwa mai bawul a ciki
strings.check.vih_not_in_flow: Tashoshin masu fesa ruwa masu bawul a ciki da ba sa cikin kowane zango (suna aiki a kowane zango)
strings.adv.vih_not_in_flow.why: An ayyana zanguna, amma waɗannan tashoshin masu fesa ruwa masu bawul a ciki ba sa cikin kowanne: tashar da ba ta cikin wani zango tana buɗewa a kowane zango, ana ƙara kwararar ta a kan ta kowane zango, kuma ba a la'akari da matsinta wajen lissafin tushe.
strings.adv.vih_not_in_flow.how: Sa tashoshin a zanguna a Ƙira → Zangon aiki (haɗawa ta atomatik ma tana sanya su) ko, idan da gaske suna aiki koyaushe, yi watsi da wannan gargaɗin.
strings.adv.vih_pressure_deficit.why: Mai fesa ruwa da ke wuri mafi wahala a tashar yana samun ƙasa da matsinsa na asali: tushen ba shi da matsin shawo kan asara a babban bututu da hawa zuwa gare shi.
strings.adv.vih_pressure_deficit.how: Sa ko canza famfo (gyara yana zaɓar ɗaya don kwarara da matsi), yi amfani da manyan bututu a babban bututu ko raba tashoshin cikin ƙarin zanguna. Idan matsin tushe hasashe ne kawai, bari shirin ya lissafa shi.
strings.adv.vih_pressure_high.why: Da matsin da zangon ke buƙata a mai fesa ruwansa da ke wuri mafi wahala, masu fesa ruwa da ke ƙasa ko kusa da tushe suna wuce saman tagar bakin fesawa: suna zuba ruwa fiye da kima kuma suna yin hazo.
strings.adv.vih_pressure_high.how: Sa tashoshi masu tsayi daban-daban sosai a zanguna daban-daban, yi amfani da masu fesa ruwa masu mai daidaita matsi ko bawul na rage matsi a reshen tashoshin da ke ƙasa.
strings.rep.vihEveryFlow: Kowane zango (ba a cikin ko ɗaya)
strings.msg.noVih: Babu masu fesa ruwa masu bawul a ciki: zana emitters a babban bututu (iyakar babban bututu); waɗanda ke da sunan tasha ɗaya suna buɗewa tare.
strings.props.vihEveryFlow: Kowane zango (babu zangon da ya lissafa shi)

strings.veg.title: Wurare masu kore daga hoton sama
strings.veg.hint: Yana gano filayen ciyawa, bishiyoyi da ƙananan bishiyoyi ta launi da yanayin hoton, a nan cikin na'urar (ba a aika komai ko'ina ba), kuma yana ƙirƙirar wuraren ban ruwa daga iyakokinsu.
strings.veg.photoHint: Don amfani da hoton sama da aka shigo da shi (daga jirgi mara matuƙi, misali), zaɓe shi a zane kafin buɗe wannan taga.
strings.veg.notImagery: Taswirar tushe a allo taswira ce da aka zana, ba hoton tauraron ɗan adam ba: zaɓi {m} a {v} → {b}.
strings.veg.licence: Tabbatar cewa sharuɗɗan amfani na mai bayar da hotunan sun yarda a ciro iyakoki daga gare su: wasu suna hana zana a kan hotunansu.
strings.veg.noPhoto: Hoton da aka zaɓa ba shi da pikisal da aka saka a cikin aikin.
strings.veg.noGeoref: Aikin ba shi da matsayin wuri, don haka babu taswirar tushe da za a karanta: saita matsayin wurinsa a {f} → {g} ko zaɓi hoton sama da aka sanya a zane.
strings.veg.noMap: Babu taswirar tushe a allo: kunna {m} a {v} → {b} ka ƙara girma zuwa wurin, ko zaɓi hoton sama da aka sanya a zane.
strings.veg.mapUnreadable: Ba a iya karanta hoton taswirar ba: tiles ɗinta suna kan lodawa ko kuma sabar ba ta yarda a karanta su ba (CORS). Jira taswirar ta gama lodawa ka sake karantawa, ko zaɓi wata taswirar tushe.
strings.veg.thresholdHint: Zuwa hagu, ciyawa kodaddiya, busasshiya ko ta inuwa ma tana shiga; zuwa dama, kore mai ƙarfi kawai ke tsayawa.
strings.veg.split: Bambanta bishiyoyi da ƙananan bishiyoyi da filayen ciyawa
strings.veg.treeLimit: Matakin gano bishiyoyi da ƙananan bishiyoyi
strings.veg.treeLimitHint: Rufin ganyen bishiyoyi ya fi ciyawa duhu da kaushi: matsa zuwa dama idan ƙananan bishiyoyi suna bayyana a matsayin ciyawa, zuwa hagu idan ciyawa ta inuwa tana bayyana a matsayin rufin ganye.
strings.veg.minHole: Mafi ƙaramin rami da ake riƙe a matsayin wurin da aka ware ({u})
strings.veg.advancedHint: Tsaftacewa tana bai wa kowane pikisal rukunin mafi yawan maƙwabtansa: tana goge ɗigo-ɗigo da ratsi masu ƙunci fiye da radius kuma tana rufe ramuka masu ƙuncin haka, ba tare da matsar da gefuna ba; tsaftace rufin ganye tana yin haka ga rabuwar bishiyoyi da ciyawa. Sassautawa tana cire matakalar pikisal kafin sauƙaƙawa, ba tare da rage fadin wuri ba.

strings.veg.dropped: Ƙananan sassa ƙasa da mafi ƙarancin fadin wuri

strings.warn.veg_mostlyGreen: Kusan duka hoton tsirrai ne: ɗaga iyakar idan hanyoyi ko rufin gidaje sun shiga.

strings.ai.title: Mataimakin AI
strings.ai.needKey: Ƙara maɓallin API naka na {p} a Saituna don farawa (samfurin da aka zaɓa na {p} ne).
strings.ai.intro: Yi tambaya game da aikin da ke buɗe, ko ka umarci mataimakin ya yi abubuwa a cikinsa: tsara masu fesa ruwa, raba gona zuwa rukunai, auna tsarin bututu, gyara saƙonnin ƙira, zaɓar famfo, rubuta rahoton aiki. Yana karanta aikin da kayan aiki da injin lissafi na shirin kansa; canje-canje suna buƙatar amincewarka (Saituna), kuma ana iya warware canje-canjen kowace amsa da danna sau ɗaya. Ba a aika komai kafin ka danna Aika.
strings.ai.starters: Shawarwari (suna cike akwatin rubutu; ba a aika komai sai ka danna Aika):
strings.ai.q.zoneWindow: Me ya sa yanki {z} bai cika tagar matsi ba, kuma ta yaya zan gyara shi?
strings.ai.q.windowAny: Akwai wani yanki da ke wajen tagar matsinsa? Me ya sa, kuma ta yaya zan gyara shi?
strings.ai.q.pumping: Ta yaya zan rage kuɗin aikin famfo?
strings.ai.q.fix: Duba ƙirar ka gyara abin da ba daidai ba.
strings.ai.q.design: Yi ƙirar ban ruwa ta wurin da aka zaɓa; ka fara tambaye ni abin da kake buƙata.
strings.ai.q.trace: Zana gonakin da za a iya ba ruwa a kan hoton sama a matsayin wurare.
strings.ai.q.memorial: Rubuta rahoton fasaha (bayanin aikin dalla-dalla) na aikin.
strings.ai.q.datasheet: Ƙara abubuwan takardar bayanai da aka haɗa zuwa kasida.
strings.ai.q.attachment: Ga fayil ɗin da aka haɗa.
strings.start.title: Fara aikinka
strings.start.where: Ina filin da za a ba ruwa yake?
strings.start.whereNote: Za a saita matsayin aikin a wannan wurin, sannan taswirar tauraron ɗan adam za ta bayyana. Neman adireshi yana amfani da OpenStreetMap. Za ka iya barin wurin ba komai ka saita matsayin wuri daga baya a {f} → {g}.
strings.start.notFound: Ba a sami wani wuri ba. Gwada gari da jiha, ko liƙa daidaitawar.
strings.start.searchFailed: Binciken bai amsa ba. Sake gwadawa ko liƙa daidaitawar.
strings.start.osm: Bincike: © masu bayar da gudummawa ga OpenStreetMap
strings.start.noAi: Fara ba tare da AI ba
strings.ai.start.place: Aikin yana a {p}; an riga an saita matsayinsa a wurin.
strings.ai.start.title: Ka yi ƙira tare da Mataimakin AI?
strings.ai.start.body: Mataimakin AI zai iya yin ƙirar tare da kai. Ka bayyana filin, abin da za ka ba ruwa da kuma inda ruwan yake fitowa: zai nemo wurin a taswira, ya tsara masu fesa ruwa ko masu ɗigo, ya shimfiɗa hanyar bututu, ya auna girman komai kuma ya bayyana sakamakon. Kai ne ke amincewa da kowane canji, kuma za ka iya warware kowanne.
strings.ai.start.example: misali: gonar lemu mai hekta 5 kusa da Kano, ban ruwa na ɗigo, ruwa daga rijiyar burtsatse mai 20 m³/h
strings.ai.start.keyReady: Mataimakin zai yi amfani da {m} da maɓallin {p} naka. Ba za a aika komai ba sai ka danna “Aika”.
strings.ai.start.keyNeeded: Kana buƙatar maɓallin API daga ɗaya daga cikin kamfanonin AI (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, Meta ko OpenRouter): allon mataimakin zai nuna inda za ka samo shi. Mai bayarwa zai caji amfani a asusunka, kuma ba za a aika komai ba sai ka danna “Aika”.
strings.ai.start.never: Kada a nuna wannan allon lokacin buɗewa
strings.ai.start.prompt: Ina so in yi ƙirar sabon tsarin ban ruwa. Ka tambaye ni abin da kake buƙatar sani (wurin, abin da zan ba ruwa, inda ruwan yake fitowa), sannan ka zana kuma ka auna ƙirar tare da ni.
strings.ai.q.site: Nemo filina ta adireshinsa, saita matsayin wurin aikin a taswira kuma nuna hoton tauraron ɗan adam.
strings.ai.askStart: Nuna allon farawa idan an buɗe manhajar (wurin aiki da AI)
strings.ai.askStart.hint: Idan an buɗe manhajar, za ta tambayi inda filin yake da ko kana so ka yi ƙira tare da mataimakin.
strings.ai.key.wrongCompany: Wannan yana kama da maɓallin {p}: liƙa shi a filin {p}.
strings.ai.key.modelSet: An zaɓi samfurin {m} (ka canza shi a Samfurin AI, a sama).
strings.ai.key.oneEnough: Don farawa, maɓallin API ɗaya ya isa: daga Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), Google (Gemini), xAI (Grok), Meta (Muse) ko OpenRouter (maɓalli ɗaya don samfuran dukansu da na wasu da yawa). Mai bayarwa zai caji amfani a asusunka, kuma iyakar kashe kuɗi ga kowane aiki tana takaita kowace buƙata.

strings.ai.voice.title: Faɗar da baki
strings.ai.voice.notice: Faɗar da baki tana amfani da sabis ɗin murya na mai bincike: sautin muryarka yana zuwa sabobinsa, waɗanda suke mayar da shi rubutu (Chrome yana amfani da na Google, Edge na Microsoft, Safari kuma na Apple). Manhajar ba ta naɗa ko adana sautin, kuma mai binciken yana neman izini kafin ya yi amfani da makirufo. Rubutun da aka faɗa yana shiga akwatin saƙo kuma yana isa ga mataimakin ne kawai idan ka danna Aika.

strings.ai.voice.err.network: Sabis ɗin murya na mai binciken bai amsa ba. Faɗar da baki tana buƙatar intanet kuma tana aiki a Chrome, Edge da Safari.

strings.about.text:
OpenCADIrrigation — CAD kyauta mai buɗaɗɗen lambar tushe don ƙirar ban ruwa ta matsi: ban ruwa ta ɗigo, ƙaramin fesa ruwa, fesa ruwa, lambuna, filayen wasanni, pivot na tsakiya da injunan layi.
Injin lissafin ruwa na kansa: Hazen‑Williams, Darcy‑Weisbach, Scobey da Manning; warware hanyoyin sadarwa da Global Gradient Algorithm (Todini‑Pilati); auna girman bututu ta shirye-shiryen layi cikin iyakar ajin matsi; yanayin wucin gadi ta hanyar halaye (method of characteristics); kwaikwayo na awa 24. Yana lissafa manyan ayyuka cikin daƙiƙoƙi kaɗan.
Ƙira ta atomatik, ilimin noma, injuna, ƙiyasin farashi da takardun bugawa; DXF/DWG, PDF, KML, SHP, GeoJSON da EPANET. Zanen yana tafiya lami lafiya ko da yana da dubun dubatar abubuwa da ɗaruruwan layuka.
Takardun fasaha a shirye: teburin bayanan zane mai ƙwararren da ke da alhaki, rahoton ƙira da lissafi, teburin izinin amfani da ruwa, shirin aiki da kulawa, kasafin kuɗi mai kuɗin gudanarwa da kuɗin tsawon rai; ma'aunin ruwan ƙasa na yau da kullum, tashoshin famfo, wutar lantarkin ɗakin famfo da famfo mai amfani da hasken rana.
Yana kuma karanta layukan shuka daga hoton tauraron ɗan adam, yana duba ƙirar a kan yanayin yau da kullum na fiye da shekaru arba'in, yana hasashen ban ruwa na kwanaki masu zuwa, yana kunna shirin ban ruwa a kan zane, yana ba ƙirar daraja daga A zuwa E kuma yana karanta lanƙwasar kasida daga hoto.
Mataimakin AI na zaɓi da maɓallinka — Claude (Anthropic), GPT (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), Grok (xAI), Muse (Meta) ko ɗaruruwan samfura ta OpenRouter — wanda ke nemo wurin, ya zana, ya auna girma kuma ya bayyana ƙirar tare da kai; ana iya amincewa da kowane canji kuma a warware shi, kuma wani samfuri zai iya ba da ra'ayi na biyu.
Mataimakin yana ganin zanen a kan hoton tauraron ɗan adam, yana zana iyakokin gonaki da kansa, yana bitar ƙira kuma yana duba takarda kafin bugawa; za ka iya yi masa alamar wurare a taswira, ka yi faɗa da baki a rubuta, ka kuma aika hotunan gona masu GPS, kuma tattaunawar tana nan ko da an sake loda shafin.
Idan an buɗe ta, tana tambayar inda filin yake (adireshi ko daidaitawa) da ko kana so ka yi ƙira da AI.
Yana gudana a mai binciken gizo, har ma ba tare da intanet ba, ba tare da rajista ko sabar ba, cikin harsuna 20.

strings.res.hint: Tushen yana ɗaukar ruwansa daga tafki ko madatsar ruwa: zaɓi polyline a rufe ko wurin da ke nuna ruwan a cikakken matakinsa. Yawan ruwa yana fitowa daga samfurin ƙasa (ƙasar da ke cikin iyaka ga madatsar ruwa; ƙasa mai fili tare da gangaren gefensa ga tafkin da aka haƙa). Ƙirar tana jan ruwa daga mafi ƙasƙancin mataki; kwaikwayo na awa 24 yana bari matakin ya sauka da abin da tushe ke bayarwa ya kuma tashi da ruwan da ke shigowa.

strings.warn.air_valve_missing: Wuri mafi tsayi na babban bututu ba tare da bawul na iska ba
strings.adv.air_valve_missing.why: Layin yana hawa zuwa wurin da ya fi maƙwabtansa tsayi sannan ya sauka bayansa: iskar da ruwa ke ɗauka tana taruwa a can, tana toshe bakin bututu, tana yanke kwarara kuma tana haifar da hauhawar matsi idan ta fita kwatsam. Idan layin ya zube, wuri mafi tsayi dole kuma ya bar iska ta shiga don kada bututu ya kasance a cikin vacuum.
strings.adv.air_valve_missing.how: Sa bawul na iska mai aiki biyu (combination) a wuri mafi tsayi (Babban bututu → Bawuloli na iska yana ba da shawarar wuri da girma), ko bi da layin ba tare da wuri mafi tsayi ba.
strings.warn.zone_pressure_unreachable: Masu fitar da ruwa na yankin ba za su iya kai matsinsu na asali ba: na'urar daidaitawa ta yankin tana riƙe matsin
strings.adv.zone_pressure_unreachable.why: Bawul na rage matsi (PRV), na riƙe matsi (PSV) ko na sarrafa kwarara (FCV) a cikin yankin yana riƙe matsin masu fitar da ruwa ƙasa da na asali komai yawan matsin da bawul ɗin yanki ke samu. Nazarin yana ɗaukar mafi ƙarancin matsin bawul da ya riga ya ba yankin duk abin da zai iya samu.
strings.adv.zone_pressure_unreachable.how: Saita matsin (ko kwararar) mai daidaitawa sama da abin da masu fitar da ruwa ke buƙata tare da asarar da ke bayansa, ko ƙara girman bututun da ke tsakanin mai daidaitawa da masu fitar da ruwa.
strings.warn.pump_below_min_flow: Famfo yana ƙasa da mafi ƙarancin kwararar lanƙwasarsa (kusa da rufewa)
strings.adv.pump_below_min_flow.why: Famfon yana aiki ƙasa da mafi ƙarancin kwararar mai ƙera (a saurin da yake juyawa): kusa da rufewa ruwa yana zagayawa a cikin impeller, yana yin zafi kuma famfo yana girgiza, da ƙaramin inganci.
strings.adv.pump_below_min_flow.how: Zaɓi ƙaramin famfo, buɗe ƙarin yankuna a zangon, yi amfani da mai canza mitar wuta ko layin kauce wa (bypass).
strings.warn.lp_iteration_limit: LP ya tsaya a iyakar maimaitawarsa (an yi amfani da hanyar kwaɗayi)
strings.adv.lp_iteration_limit.why: Auna girma ta shirye-shiryen layi ya tsaya a iyakar maimaitawarsa kafin ya sami mafita: wannan ba yana nufin babu ita ba. Shirin ya yi amfani da hanyar kwaɗayi (ƙara girma mataki-mataki), wadda ke ba da sakamako mai kyau amma watakila ba mafi arha ba.
strings.adv.lp_iteration_limit.how: Raba yankin ko babban bututu zuwa ƙananan sassa, ko kunna ƙarancin diamitocin zaɓi a kasida don wannan amfani.
strings.warn.zone_slope_exceeds_window: Bambancin tsayin yankin shi kaɗai ya wuce tagar matsin masu fitar da ruwa
strings.adv.zone_slope_exceeds_window.why: Bambancin tsayi tsakanin mafi tsayi da mafi ƙasƙancin mai fitar da ruwa na yankin ya fi kewayon matsin da aka yarda: ko da babu asara ko kaɗan a bututu wasu za su kasance a wajen taga. Manyan bututu ba sa taimakawa, don haka shirin ya riƙe bututu masu arha.
strings.adv.zone_slope_exceeds_window.how: Yi amfani da masu fitar da ruwa masu daidaita matsi, shimfiɗa lateral bisa layukan tsayi, raba yankin bisa matakan tsayi ko sa masu daidaita matsi a lateral.
strings.rep.surgePath: Hanyar igiyar ruwa (tantancewa; duba nazarin yanayin wucin gadi)
strings.warn.pressure_below_atmospheric: Matsi ƙasa da na sararin sama a bututu (layin matsin ruwa yana ƙasa da bututu)
strings.adv.pressure_below_atmospheric.why: A wuri mai tsayi na hanyar layin matsin ruwa yana gudana ƙasa da bututu: ruwa yana gudana kamar siphon, cikin vacuum. Iska tana fitowa daga ruwa ta taru, kwarara tana raguwa ko ta tsaya, kuma bututu mai siririn bango (PE, PVC na ƙaramin aji) na iya rugujewa.
strings.adv.pressure_below_atmospheric.how: Ba tushe ƙarin matsi (ko famfo kafin wuri mafi tsayi), bi da layi ta kewayen tudun ko ƙara girman bututun da ke gabansa don rasa ƙarancin matsi; sa bawul na iska a wuri mafi tsayi.
strings.warn.valve_pressure_excess: Rarar matsi a bawul na yanki da ba ya daidaitawa
strings.adv.valve_pressure_excess.why: Babban bututu yana bayar da matsi a bawul fiye da abin da yankin ke buƙata da nisa (fiye da m 5 da 20 %). Bawul na solenoid na yau da kullum ba ya riƙe matsi: yankin yana aiki sama da matsin ƙirarsa, masu fitar da ruwa suna bayar da ƙarin kwarara, don haka kwararar layi da ta famfo tana canzawa.
strings.adv.valve_pressure_excess.how: Yi amfani da bawul mai daidaita matsi (da matukin ragewa) ko saita matsin fita na bawul, ko sa mai daidaita matsi a mashigar yankin.

Fadin wurin da aka lissafa yana fitowa ba daidai ba (zai iya faɗuwa zuwa sifili), tare da buƙatar ruwa, yawan ruwa, izinin ruwa da jadawali.
strings.adv.area_self_intersect.how: Yi amfani da gyaran da ke raba wurin zuwa wurare masu sauƙi da iyakar ke kewayewa (kowanne da amfanin gona da bayanai iri ɗaya), ko matsar da kusurwoyin don kada ta sake ratsawa.

strings.check.pipes_overlap: Bututu ko lateral a kan juna
strings.adv.pipes_overlap.why: Bututu, lateral ko tef biyu na iyaka ɗaya suna gudana a kan juna a wani sashe (bututun da aka manna sau biyu, guda biyu da aka zana a wuri ɗaya, lateral da ya juya baya). Ƙirar tana ɗaukar su a matsayin bututu a layi ɗaya, da ƙarancin gogayya, kuma jerin kayan aiki yana ƙidaya sashen sau biyu.
strings.adv.pipes_overlap.how: Idan abu ɗaya ne da aka zana sau biyu, yi amfani da gyaran don riƙe ɗaya kaɗai. In ba haka ba, share ko yanke sashen da aka maimaita, ko matsar da ɗaya daga cikin bututun gefe idan da gaske layuka biyu ne a rami ɗaya.
strings.check.zone_spacing_wide: Masu fesa ruwa sun fi nisa da juna fiye da yadda jefawarsu ta yarda
strings.adv.zone_spacing_wide.why: Masu fesa ruwa na cikakken da'ira na wannan yankin suna nesa da juna fiye da yadda radius na jiƙawarsu ya yarda: wani zirin da ke tsakaninsu yana samun ƙarancin ruwa sosai, kuma babu lokacin ban ruwa da zai gyara hakan ba tare da jiƙe sauran ba. Kai-da-kai (head to head) shi ne 50 % na diamitar jiƙa; a ƙaramar iska ana karɓar kusan 60 % a grid mai murabba'i ko mai kusurwa uku, da 50–55 % ta 60–65 % a mai tsawo da faɗi (Keller da Bliesner), ƙasa da haka idan akwai iska.
strings.adv.zone_spacing_wide.how: Yi amfani da bakin fesawa mai babban radius (saƙon yana nuna mafi girman tazara ga na yanzu), kusantar da layuka ko masu fesa ruwa, ko ƙara layi tsakanin na yanzu. Tsarawa ta atomatik da samfura suna tazartawa kai-da-kai.
strings.check.area_uniformity_low: Wurin ya sami ruwa ba daidai ba
strings.adv.area_uniformity_low.why: Densogram na masu fesa ruwa (kowanne a matsinsa na asali, duk wanda ke jefa ruwa a wurin) yana nuna rarrabawa mara kyau: CU na Christiansen ƙasa da 75 %, DU na kwata mafi ƙanƙanta ƙasa da 60 % ko fiye da 5 % na wurin da ke samun ƙasa da rabin matsakaici. Sassan da suka bushe suna tilasta dogon lokacin ban ruwa wanda ke ɓata ruwa a sauran.
strings.adv.area_uniformity_low.how: Buɗe densogram don ganin inda ruwa ya yi ƙaranci. Kusantar da masu fesa ruwa (tazara har zuwa radius), canza bakunan fesawa don daidaita ruwan sama (rabin da'ira da rabin kwarara), sa da'irori na sashi a gefuna, ko sake tsara wurin da tsarawa ta atomatik ko samfuri.

strings.check.area_rate_exceeds_soil: Ƙimar zubawa ta fi abin da ƙasa ke sha
strings.adv.area_rate_exceeds_soil.why: Masu fesa ruwa na wurin suna zuba ruwa da sauri fiye da yadda ƙasa, a gangarenta, za ta iya sha (USDA NEH 15, babi 11, Tebur 11-4). Ruwa yana kwanciya kuma yana gudana: ƙasa da zurfin ƙira ne ke shiga ƙasa, kuma ƙasa tana zaizayewa.
strings.adv.area_rate_exceeds_soil.how: Raba kowane ban ruwa zuwa gajerun zagaye da hutu don ruwa ya jiƙa (zagaye da hutun shan ruwa: saƙon yana bayar da zagayen, mintunan kowanne da hutun), ko yi amfani da bakunan fesawa masu ƙarancin kwarara, rotors ko tazara mafi faɗi.
strings.check.area_eto_climate: ETo na wurin ban ruwa ya bambanta da yanayin wurin
strings.adv.area_eto_climate.why: Wurin yana lissafa zurfinsa da ETo da aka rubuta a kansa, amma yanayin wurin yana da wani ETo a watan da buƙata ta fi yawa. Zurfi, lokutan ban ruwa da shirin mai sarrafawa suna gaza (ko suna wuce) abin da yanayin ke nema.
strings.adv.area_eto_climate.how: Rubuta a wurin ETo na watan ƙira na yanayin (ƙimar da ke bayan alamar /), ko zaɓi amfanin gona na teburin FAO-56, wanda ke amfani da yanayin wata bayan wata.
strings.check.area_planting_date: Ranar shuka mai ruɗani ko ba kwanan wata ba
strings.adv.area_planting_date.why: Ranar shukar da aka rubuta ba kwanan wata ba ce, ko ranarta da watanta za su iya musanya (05/09 shi ne 5 ga Satumba ko 9 ga Mayu). Kwanan watan yana ƙayyade watannin da amfanin gona ke a gona, watan ƙoli, yawan ruwa da kwarara.
strings.adv.area_planting_date.how: Rubuta kwanan watan a matsayin DD/MM da rana sama da 12, a matsayin MM-DD ko da sunan wata (15 Sep). Allon wurin yana nuna yadda aka karanta kwanan watan.
strings.check.area_leaching_infeasible: Ruwan yana da gishiri da yawa ga amfanin gona
strings.adv.area_leaching_infeasible.why: Ruwan ban ruwan yana da gishiri sosai ga amfanin gona har babu kason wanke gishiri da zai riƙe yiwuwar amfanin da aka nema (5·ECe ≤ ECw, FAO-29). Zurfin gabaɗaya da yawan ruwan waɗannan watanni ba sa cikin jimilla.
strings.adv.area_leaching_infeasible.how: Rage yiwuwar amfanin wurin, zaɓi amfanin gona mai jurewa ko yi amfani da wani ruwa (ko haɗin ruwaye) mai ƙarancin gishiri.
strings.warn.elec_station_current: Tasha tana jan lantarki fiye da abin da fitar mai sarrafawa ke bayarwa
strings.adv.elec_station_current.why: Solenoids na tasha suna buɗewa tare kuma lantarkin farawarsu (inrush) ya fi abin da fitar mai sarrafawa ɗaya ke bayarwa (ba tare da bayanan mai sarrafawa ba, 0.56 A, na yau da kullum a masu sarrafawa na 24 V AC). Bawul na iya ƙin buɗewa kuma fitar na iya ƙonewa.
strings.adv.elec_station_current.how: Yi amfani da relay na tasha mai wutarsa ta kansa, raba tashar gida biyu, ko shigar a mai sarrafawa lantarkin kowace tasha da mai ƙera ya bayyana.
strings.warn.elec_overcurrent: Lantarkin zango ya wuce abin da mai sarrafawa ke bayarwa
strings.adv.elec_overcurrent.why: A mafi munin lokaci na zango (tasha tana buɗewa yayin da sauran ke kunne, ko babban bawul yana buɗewa tare da tasha ta farko) jimlar lantarki ta fi abin da mai sarrafawa ke bayarwa (ba tare da bayanan mai sarrafawa ba, 1.5 A, transformer na kusan 40 VA).
strings.adv.elec_overcurrent.how: Buɗe ƙarancin tashoshi tare (ƙarin zanguna ko iyakar tashoshi a lokaci ɗaya), sa relays a babban bawul da manyan tashoshi, ko shigar da jimlar lantarkin mai sarrafawar da aka zaɓa.

strings.adv.pivot_pkg_slow_drive.why: A saurin hasumiya ta ƙarshe a 100 %, juyi yana ɗaukar awanni fiye da zagayen ƙira: mafi ƙanƙantar zurfi ga kowane juyi ya fi zurfin ƙira, kuma ban ruwa mara zurfi ba zai yiwu ba.
strings.adv.pivot_pkg_slow_drive.how: Yi amfani da motar giya mai sauri, wani rabon akwatin giya ko manyan taya (saurin da ke riƙe zagayen yana bayyana tare da teburin mai ƙidaya lokaci), ko ƙara awanni ga zagaye da zurfin ƙira.

strings.swb.title: Ma'aunin ruwan ƙasa na yau da kullum
strings.swb.hint: Kowace rana a yankin saiwa (FAO-56, babi 8): amfanin gona yana amfani da Kr·Kc·ETo, yana shiga damuwa (Ks) da zarar raguwar ruwa ta wuce ruwan da ke samuwa cikin sauƙi, ruwan sama ƙasa da 0.2·ETo yana ƙafewa kuma rarar tana zurarewa ƙasa. Ban ruwa yana cike raguwar idan ta kai iyakar kowane mataki; sama da ma'aunin p ban ruwa ne na ƙarancin ruwa mai tsari (regulated deficit), tare da asarar amfani bisa Ky (FAO-33).

strings.ro.hint: Pivot na tsakiya da injunan layi, tsawo bayan tsawo: siffar ellipse ta masu fesa ruwa (ƙoli = 4/π na matsakaici, komai saurin) a gaban iyalin shan ruwa na NRCS na ƙasar wurin da ke ƙarƙashin injin da ajiyar samansa; yana bayar da mafi girman zurfi ga kowane wucewa ba tare da kwarara a saman ƙasa ba da mafi ƙanƙantar saitin mai ƙidaya lokaci. Wuraren masu fesa ruwa: ƙimar a gaban shan ruwan ƙasa na asali, tare da zagaye da hutun shan ruwa da ke hana kwarara a saman ƙasa.

strings.adv.capacity_below_peak.why: Idan aka haɗa awannin da kowane zango ke buƙata a ranar ƙoli (wurin kowane zango da ke buƙata mafi yawa: yawan ruwa gabaɗaya na watan ƙira bisa kwararar masu fitar da ruwansa), ranar ta fi tagar ban ruwa ta shirin tsawo (awa 24 ba tare da taga ba). Amfanin gona yana samun ƙasa da buƙatar ƙoli gabaɗaya.
strings.adv.capacity_below_peak.how: Haɗa yankuna zuwa zangunan da ke aiki tare (idan tushe da famfo sun yarda), ƙara kwararar masu fitar da ruwa, faɗaɗa tagar ban ruwa ko raba tsarin da wani tushe.
strings.check.pivot_capacity_below_peak: Injin bai kai buƙatar ƙoli ba
strings.adv.pivot_capacity_below_peak.why: Zurfin kowane juyi a awannin tagar ban ruwa (zurfi × taga / awanni ga juyi) ya yi ƙasa da buƙatar ƙoli gabaɗaya ta wurin da ke ƙarƙashin injin: a watan da buƙata ta fi yawa ƙasa tana ci gaba da bushewa.
strings.adv.pivot_capacity_below_peak.how: Ƙara zurfin ƙira ko gajarta awanni ga juyi (ƙarin kwarara), faɗaɗa tagar ban ruwa ko sake duba amfanin gona da yanayin wurin.
strings.check.pivot_runoff: Kwararar saman ƙasa a ƙarƙashin injin
strings.adv.pivot_runoff.why: A ƙarshen injin ƙimar ƙoli ta siffar masu fesa ruwa ta wuce shigar ruwa cikin ƙasa (iyalin NRCS na wurin da ke ƙarƙashin pivot) fiye da abin da saman ƙasa ke riƙewa: wani ɓangare na zurfi yana gudana, gona tana samun ruwa ba daidai ba kuma ƙasa tana zaizayewa.
strings.adv.pivot_runoff.how: Zuba ƙananan zurfi ga kowane juyi (mai ƙidaya lokaci mai sauri; saƙon yana bayar da mafi girman zurfi ba tare da kwararar saman ƙasa ba), yi amfani da masu fesa ruwa masu babban diamitar jiƙa (ƙoli ƙasa), sanduna (booms) masu ƙarin mafita ko hanyoyin riƙe ruwa (ragowar amfanin gona, ƙananan madatsun kunya).
strings.prog.title: Shirin ban ruwa na mai sarrafawa
strings.prog.hint: Zanguna suna aiki ɗaya bayan ɗaya daga farkon tagar ban ruwa ta yau da kullum. Da zagaye da hutun shan ruwa, taron yankin masu fesa ruwa wanda ƙasarsa ba ta sha ƙimarsa ana raba shi zuwa gajerun zagaye da hutu don jiƙewa, kuma wasu zanguna suna aiki a lokacin hutun. Daidaitawar lokaci-lokaci tana bayar da kason lokacin ban ruwa na watan ƙira da kowane wata ke buƙata.

Rijiyoyi, famfuna da bututun samar da ruwa sau da yawa suna a wajen wurin da aka yi safiyo, kuma kuskuren mita kaɗan a tsayi yana canza matsin da famfo dole ya shawo kansa.

strings.cat.pnAsk.title: Naúrar ginshiƙin PN
strings.cat.pnAsk.body: Layuka {n} suna da PN da bai wuce 25 ba ba tare da naúra ba. Bisa ISO, PN 10 shi ne bar 10 (m 102); bututun ban ruwa na Brazil suna bayar da PN 40, 60 da 80 a mitocin ruwa. Ta yaya za a karanta waɗannan ƙimomin?
strings.cat.importInUse: Abubuwa {n} da aka maye ana amfani da su a zane ({v}): duba diamitocinsu, lanƙwasoshinsu da farashinsu.
strings.cat.importSkipped: An bar layuka {n} marasa diamita, lanƙwasa ko sashe a waje (layuka {v}).
strings.cat.importUnits: Bawuloli: kv = ma'aunin kwarara (m³/h a asarar bar 1), kcoef = K na K·v²/2g, k da n = dokar h = k·Q^n (Q a m³/s). Aji: ratingM a mita; pn a bar har zuwa 25 kuma a mita sama da haka; naúra a cikin akwati (bar, psi, kPa, MPa, m) ce ke rinjaye. Ba tare da ginshiƙin id ba, layi iri ɗaya da aka sake shigo da shi yana maye abinsa, ba wani ba.

strings.basemap.osm.title: Sabar taswirar tituna
strings.basemap.osm.explain: Taswirar tituna tana amfani da tiles na OpenStreetMap. Masu sa kai ne ke gudanar da sabar OpenStreetMap Foundation, kuma manufofinta suna roƙon manhajoji kada su yi amfani da ita sosai: masu amfani da yawa (ko kamfani) su yi amfani da wata sabar mai tiles iri ɗaya, tasu ko ta biyan kuɗi. Bar shi babu komai don amfani da ta Foundation.
strings.basemap.terms.title: Sharuɗɗan taswirorin tushe
strings.basemap.terms.intro: Taswirorin tushe suna fitowa daga sabis na wasu kamfanoni, kowanne da sharuɗɗansa. Ana nuna yabon kowanne a kan taswira (da hanyar haɗi) da kuma a takardun da aka fitar.
strings.basemap.terms.osm: Bayanai © masu ba da gudummawa ga OpenStreetMap (ODbL). Masu sa kai ne ke gudanar da sabar Foundation: manufarta tana neman yabo kuma ba amfani mai yawa ba; takardun da aka fitar suna ɗaukar ƙarancin tiles ɗinta. Don amfani mai yawa, saita wata sabar (Sabar taswirar tituna…).
strings.basemap.terms.topo: Bayanai © masu ba da gudummawa ga OpenStreetMap, SRTM; salo © OpenTopoMap (CC-BY-SA). Sabar kyauta mai ƙarancin ƙarfi: guji amfani mai yawa.
strings.basemap.terms.carto: Bayanai © masu ba da gudummawa ga OpenStreetMap, salo © CARTO. Taswirorin tushe na CARTO kyauta ne don amfani ba na kasuwanci ba; amfanin kasuwanci yana buƙatar lasisin CARTO.

strings.help.chapterLang: Cikakken littafin jagora yana cikin Turanci da Portuguese, a ma'ajiyar lambar aikin.
strings.help.b.start: Fara daga allon farawa: faɗi inda filin yake (adireshi, daidaitawa ko hanyar haɗin Google Maps) kuma, idan ka so, ka roƙi Mataimakin AI ya yi ƙirar. Fayil → Misalai yana buɗe ayyuka 15 da aka shirya, kuma Taimako → Koyarwa mai mu'amala tana koyarwa mataki-mataki, a babi-babi, da gajeriyar hanya don wayoyi da hanyoyi masu sauri bisa nau'in aiki. Komai yana gudana a mai binciken gizo: babu abin da ake buƙatar girkawa, kuma ana riƙe aikin a wannan mai binciken gizo yayin da kake aiki.
strings.help.b.workflow: Ƙira tana bi ta waɗannan matakai: 1) gano wurin (Fayil → Matsayin wuri (georeference)) ka sa taswirar tauraron ɗan adam ƙarƙashin zane; 2) sauke ƙasa (Ƙira → Ƙasa); 3) zana wuraren ban ruwa; 4) gina hanyar bututu — tushe, famfo, babban bututu, bawuloli, manifolds, lateral da masu fitar da ruwa —, da hannu ko da Ƙira → Ƙira ta atomatik; 5) duba sigogi da kasida; 6) yi lissafin ƙira (F5) ka karanta duba ƙira da saƙonni; 7) fitar da takardu, rahotanni da ƙiyasin farashi.
strings.help.b.interface: Menus a sama, shafukan ayyukan da ke buɗe, akwatin kayan aiki a hagu, allon zane a tsakiya, allon gefe (Kaddarori, Layuka, Tarihi) a dama, rahotanni a ƙasa (F2) da sandar matsayi mai daidaitawa da maɓallan Kamawa, Ortho da Grid. Ctrl+K yana nemo kowane menu, umarni ko saiti ta sunansa. A Kallo → Fuskar manhaja kana canza girman fuskar manhaja, kunna bambancin launi mai ƙarfi, ninke allon gefe (ko ja gefensa don faɗaɗa shi) ka shiga yanayin mai da hankali (Ctrl+Alt+F), wanda ke barin allon zane kaɗai.
strings.help.b.shortcuts: Da zanen yana da hankali, rubuta gajeriyar sunan umarni ka danna Enter ko Space (L layi, PL polyline, ZP bututun yanki, MP babban bututu, V bawul…); cikakken gajeren suna yana kuma gudana da kansa bayan ɗan dakata. Ana kuma rubuta daidaitawa da nisa: 25,10 cikakken wuri ne, @5,0 na dangi kuma @25<90 na polar. Esc yana sokewa, Backspace yana warware wuri na ƙarshe, F3 yana kunna/kashe kamawa, F8 ortho, F9 kama grid, kuma Shift yana kulle kusurwa zuwa matakan 45°. Taimako → Gajerun hanyoyin allon maɓalli yana jera komai; a allon taɓawa maɓallin ⌨ yana buɗe layin umarni iri ɗaya.
strings.help.b.phone: A waya (ko a ƙuntatacciyar taga) allon yana canzawa: menu ☰ a sama, tare da bincike, shafuka da ayyukan kwanan nan; sandar kayan aiki bisa rukuni a ƙasa; da maɓallai masu zagaye maimakon maɓallan allon maɓalli: ✓ An gama (Enter), ✕ Soke (Esc), ⌨ don rubuta umarni, daidaitawa da tsawo, Warware, Kaddarori da Rahotanni, waɗanda ke buɗewa a takardu masu zamewa. Matse yatsu yana zuƙowa, yatsu biyu suna motsa kallo kuma yatsa ɗaya yana zana. A kwamfutar hannu a tsaye allon gefe yana zama aljihun tebur a dama.
strings.help.b.drawing: Menus na Zana da Gyara suna ɗauke da abubuwan CAD (layi, polyline, da'ira, baka, spline, zane-zane, rubutu, ma'auni, layukan nuni) da gyare-gyare (matsar da kwafa da wurin tushe, juya, madubi, ma'auni, gusar, datse, tsawaita, miƙa, zagaye kusurwa, yanke kusurwa a karkace, karya, haɗa, fasa, jeri). Kamawa (F3) yana riƙe kibiyar linzami a ƙarshe, tsakiya, cibiya, mahaɗa da kusurwa 90°; F8 yana kunna ortho. Zaɓa da dannawa, da taga (daga hagu zuwa dama: abin da ke ciki kawai) ko taga mai ratsawa (daga dama zuwa hagu), da igiyar lasso ko da shinge; Gyara → Zaɓi yana da masu kama da juna, zaɓi mai sauri bisa kaddara da bisa layer.
strings.help.b.layers: Shafin Layuka na allon gefe yana jera layukan aikin. Ido yana nunawa ko ɓoyewa, makulli yana kullewa (abu a layer da aka kulle ba a zaɓe shi ko a gyara shi), akwatin launi yana canza launi kuma ɗigo yana nuna layer na yanzu, inda sabbin layuka, rubutu da alamomi ke zuwa. Sabon layer, a ƙasan shafin, yana ƙirƙirar ɗaya; danna sau biyu yana sake masa suna kuma Share yana mayar da abubuwansa zuwa layer na Zane (DRAWING). Abubuwan ruwa suna zaune a layukansu na kansu, waɗanda DXF, DWG da bayanin layuka na takarda ke riƙewa.
strings.help.b.history: Shafin Tarihi yana nuna kowane canji na aikin tun lokacin da aka buɗe shi. Danna yanayi na baya yana mayar da aikin zuwa gare shi (kamar warware sau da yawa) kuma danna sabon yanayi yana sake ci gaba, har sai ka yi sabon canji. Ctrl+Z yana warwarewa kuma Ctrl+Y yana sake yi. Tarihin yana ɗorewa yayin da shafin ke buɗe; sigogin da aka ajiye suna a Fayil → Tarihin sigogi.
strings.help.b.properties: Shafin Kaddarori yana nuna kuma yana gyara abin da aka zaɓa: layer, tsayi, kayan aikin kasida (bututu, mai fitar da ruwa, bawul, famfo), matsi da kwararar ƙira kuma, bayan lissafi, sakamako (matsi, kwarara, gudu, asarar matsi). Idan an zaɓi abubuwa da yawa iri ɗaya, ƙimar da aka rubuta tana zuwa duka, kuma “(ƙimomi daban-daban)” yana nuna lokacin da ba su yarda ba. Lambobi suna bin tsarin rubutun harshen da naúrorin Kayan aiki → Ma'auni; ana ajiye fili ne kawai idan ka canza shi ka bar shi (Enter ko Tab).
strings.help.b.network: Hanyar ruwan tana farawa daga tushen ruwa (WS) da famfo (PU), tana bi ta babban bututu (MP), zuwa bawuloli na sarrafawa (V); bayan kowane bawul akwai bututun yanki (ZP), manifolds, lateral (SL), tef da bututun ɗigo (DT) da masu fitar da ruwa (EM). Abubuwa suna haɗuwa a ƙarshensu: waɗanda ba a haɗa ba suna bayyana a ja, kuma duba ƙira yana nuna su. Masu samarwa suna yin aikin maimaitawa: rukunin lateral (B) yana cike wuri da lateral kuma grid na masu fesa ruwa (AH) yana tsara masu fesa ruwa.
strings.help.b.auto: Ƙira → Ƙira ta atomatik yana yin sassan ƙira daga wuraren: tsara masu fesa ruwa ta atomatik (LAYOUT) yana sanya masu fesa ruwa da yankuna; samfuran ciyawar wasanni da golf (TPL); raba gona zuwa rukunai da yankuna (SUBDIV); zoben ɗigo kewaye da bishiyoyi (RINGS); daidaita pivot da gona (PFIT); da gano tsirrai a hoton tauraron ɗan adam (VEG). Kowanne yana nuna samfoti kafin aiwatarwa, kuma ana warware komai da Ctrl+Z. Sannan Gyara kai tsaye (FIX) da Inganta ƙira (OPT) suna share gargaɗi kuma suna rage kuɗi, suna tambaya a shawarwarin ƙira.
strings.help.b.catalog: Ƙira → Kasidar kayan aiki tana ɗauke da bututu, masu fitar da ruwa, tef, bawuloli, famfuna, mahaɗai da wayoyin da aikin zai iya amfani da su, tare da farashi a kuɗin aikin. Kashe abin da bai kamata ya shiga auna girma ba, shigo da maƙunsar bayanai na CSV ko kunshin masana'anta (.oci.cat) kuma yi amfani da “Yi amfani a matsayin tsoho ga sabbin ayyuka” don fara kowane aiki da kasidarka. Maido da kasidar masana'anta da manta tsohonka suna tambaya tukuna, kuma ana warware kasidar da aka maye da Ctrl+Z.
strings.help.b.terrain: Fayil → Matsayin wuri (georeference) yana ɗaure asalin zane da latitude da longitude (ko da daidaitawar UTM): tare da shi akwai taswirar tushe (Kallo → Taswirar tushe, tauraron ɗan adam ba tare da maɓalli ba), ƙasa da fitarwar KML, GeoJSON da GPX. Ƙira → Ƙasa yana sauke tsayi daga intanet (DEM) a kan wurin, yana samar da layukan tsayi kuma yana nuna kallon 3D; layukan tsayi, wuraren tsayi da layukan karyewa da ka zana suna kuma shiga samfurin ƙasa (TIN ko IDW), wanda kowane bututu da mai fitar da ruwa ke ɗaukar tsayinsa daga gare shi don lissafin matsi.
strings.help.b.params: Ƙira → Sigogin ƙira yana saita ƙa'idodin auna girma: kewayon bambancin matsi da kwarara a masu fitar da ruwa (daidaito), mafi girman gudu a bututu, dabarar asarar matsi, izinin matsi, matsin tushe da zaɓuɓɓukan auna girman babban bututu da na yankuna, ban da farashin wuta da riba ta kuɗin shekara. Soke ko Esc yana warware abin da aka canza a taga; OK yana riƙe duka a matsayin mataki ɗaya na tarihi kuma yana watsar da sakamakon lissafin da ya gabata.
strings.help.b.check: Ƙira → Duba ƙira (CHK) yana duba zane kafin da bayan lissafi: abubuwan da ba a haɗa ba, wurare ba tare da masu fitar da ruwa ba, tazara da daidaito, ƙimar zubawa a gaban ƙasa, matsi da gudu a wajen kewayo. Kowane saƙo yana faɗin me ya sa da yadda ake gyarawa, yana da Nuna a zanen (yana zaɓa kuma yana nuna abin) kuma, inda zai yiwu, gyara da dannawa ɗaya. Gyara kai tsaye (FIX) yana aiwatar da gyare-gyare masu aminci kuma yana tambaya a shawarwari; Inganta ƙira (OPT) yana rage kuɗi tare da riƙe ƙa'idodi. Saƙonni iri ɗaya suna cikin shafin Saƙonni na rahotanni.
strings.help.b.analyses: Menu na Babban bututu yana ɗauke da nazarin aiki: yanayin wucin gadi na ruwa da bugun ruwa, bawuloli na iska a tsawon bayanin tsayi, kwaikwayo na awa 24, aiki bisa buƙata (Clément), muhimmancin bututu, daidaita ƙaushi daga matsin da aka auna da taki ta ruwan ban ruwa; menu na Ƙira yana da farashin wuta bisa lokaci tare da jadawalin zanguna da haɗa yankuna bisa makamashi. Kowane nazari yana farawa daga sakamakon lissafi na ƙarshe (F5), kuma masu tsawo suna da Soke.
strings.help.b.agronomy: Ƙira → Yanayin wurin yana kawo ƙafewar ruwa ta tunani (ETo) wata bayan wata, kuma kowane wuri yana ɗaukar amfanin gonarsa, ƙasa, Kc da rufin ƙasa: shafin Ilimin noma na rahotanni yana bayar da buƙatar ruwa, zurfi da tazarar lokaci. Ƙira → Zangon aiki yana tara yankunan da ke aiki tare, kuma shirin mai sarrafawa yana fitowa daga Fayil → Fitar da rahoto. Menu na Kayan aiki yana da kalkuletocin gona: lateral a gangare, famfo da lanƙwasar tsarin, bugun ruwa, famfo mai hasken rana, kwan jiƙa, kasafin ruwan lambu, injin bututun naɗi mai tafiya, ban ruwa ta saman ƙasa da bututu mai ƙofofi.
strings.help.b.reports: Allon rahotanni (F2, ko sandar da ke ƙarƙashin allon zane) yana da shafi ɗaya ga kowane batu: yankuna, bututu, masu fitar da ruwa, babban bututu, kayan aiki, kuɗi, ilimin noma, jadawali, saƙonni, sharhi da ƙari. Danna taken ginshiƙi don jerawa, tace layuka da rubutu, nuna waɗanda aka haskaka kawai, kwafa layukan da ake gani don mannawa a maƙunsar bayanai ko ajiye shafin a matsayin CSV; danna layi yana nemo abinsa a zane. Fayil → Fitar da rahoto yana rubuta dukansu a matsayin CSV, TXT, XLSX ko PDF.
strings.help.b.sheets: Fayil → Fitar da zane → PDF (Ctrl+P) yana tsara takarda: girman takarda da fuskantarwa, ma'auni (ko daidaitawa da takarda), teburin bayanan zane da bayanan Fayil → Bayanan aiki, bayanin layuka, kibiyar arewa, sandar ma'auni, kayan aiki a takarda da taswirar tushe ƙarƙashin zane. Saiti ɗaya na iya samun takarda ɗaya ga kowane yanki ko wuri, kallon yanzu, takardun dalla-dalla da zane-zanen ginshiƙi da rahotanni a ƙarshe. Samfotin yana nuna kowace takarda kafin fitarwa; PNG yana fitar da takarda iri ɗaya a matsayin hoto.
strings.help.b.quote: Ƙira → Ƙiyasin farashi yana mayar da jerin kayan aiki zuwa tayi: riba a kan kayan aiki da ladar aiki, ƙarin abubuwa, haraji, wa'adi da sharuɗɗa, a kuɗin aikin. Ƙira → Madadin ƙira yana riƙe nau'o'in ƙirar (da wani bututu ko wani famfo, misali) kuma yana kwatanta su a kuɗin girkawa, makamashi da kuɗin shekara. Farashin wuta bisa lokaci yana saita kuɗin makamashi bisa awannin zanguna.
strings.help.b.formats: Fayil → Shigo (Ctrl+I) yana shigo da DXF, DWG (sigogi 2000 zuwa 2018), DGN, PDF na vector, KML/KMZ, SHP, GeoJSON, GPX, LandXML, LAS, EPANET (.inp), wuraren CSV/XYZ/PNEZD da hotuna (JPG, PNG, GeoTIFF). Fitar da zane yana rubuta DXF (R2000 da R12), DWG, PDF, SVG, KML/KMZ, GeoJSON, Shapefile, GPX, LandXML, IFC, EPANET da PNG; Fitar da rahoto yana rubuta CSV, TXT, XLSX da PDF. Aikin kansa buɗaɗɗen fayil ne na JSON (.oci.json), ana ajiye shi da Ctrl+S tare da sakamakon.
strings.help.b.ai: Mataimakin AI na zaɓi ne kuma yana aiki a kan aikin da ke buɗe da kayan aiki iri ɗaya da na menus. Buɗe shi da Ƙira → Mataimakin AI, zaɓi kamfanin a saitunansa (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, Meta ko OpenRouter), manna maɓallinka na wannan kamfani ka zaɓi yanayi: karatu kawai, tsari da farko, tambaya kafin kowane canji ko aiwatarwa da kansa. Kowace buƙata tana tafiya kai tsaye daga mai binciken gizo zuwa mai bayarwa, wanda ke caji asusunka, kuma ba a aika komai kafin Aika. Ana warware kowace amsa da dannawa ɗaya, /review yana bitar ƙira ba tare da canza komai ba, /second yana neman ra'ayi na biyu daga wani samfuri game da amsar ƙarshe, kuma Yi alamar wuri da Yi alamar layi suna nuna inda kake son wani abu.
strings.help.b.storage: Ana ajiye aikin da kansa a wannan mai binciken gizo kowane ɗan daƙiƙa kaɗan, kuma Ctrl+S yana sauke fayil ɗin .oci.json (kowane Ajiye yana kuma riƙe siga, a Fayil → Tarihin sigogi). Idan aka sake buɗe shafin, manhajar tana bayar da dawo da aikin da ba a ajiye ba. Fayil → Ma'ajiyar mai binciken gizo yana nuna sararin da aka yi amfani da shi, yana sauke duka a zip kuma yana share kwafi. Babu abin da ke barin mai binciken gizo sai ka nema: taswirar tushe, ƙasa da yanayi suna fitowa daga sabis na jama'a, kuma Mataimakin AI yana magana ne kawai da mai bayarwar da ka zaɓa.

strings.fb.githubTip: Yana buɗe fom ɗin batun GitHub a sabon shafi, an cike shi; kana bitarsa ka aika (ana buƙatar asusun GitHub na kyauta).
strings.fb.long: Rubutun ya yi tsawo ga hanyar haɗi: farkonsa yana shiga fom ɗin kuma an kwafi dukan rubutun; manna shi a batun.

strings.new.v160.help: Taimako → Littafin jagora da “?” a manyan tagogi da alluna suna bayyana kowane ɓangare, tare da cikakken babi a dannawa ɗaya; Taimako → Ba da rahoton matsala ko ba da shawarar wani abu yana shirya batun GitHub.
strings.new.v160.interface: Kallo → Fuskar manhaja: girman fuskar manhaja, bambancin launi mai ƙarfi, allon gefe da ke ninkewa kuma yana riƙe faɗinsa, da yanayin mai da hankali (Ctrl+Alt+F).
strings.new.v160.tutorial: Koyarwar tana da babi-babi, tana ci gaba daga inda ka tsaya, tana da gajeriyar hanya don allon taɓawa da hanyoyi masu sauri bisa nau'in aiki, kuma yanzu tana rufe ƙira ta atomatik, takardu da Mataimakin AI.
strings.new.v160.sheets: Fitar da takarda yana nuna samfotin kowace takarda ta saitin kafin fitarwa.
strings.new.v160.numbers: Lambobi a tsarin rubutun harshen: waƙafin ɗigon ƙima a allo inda ake amfani da shi, kuma ana karanta “2.000” a matsayin dubu biyu inda ɗigo ke raba dubbai.
strings.new.v160.touch: Wayoyi da kwamfutar hannu: shafuka da ayyukan kwanan nan a ☰, umarni, daidaitawa da tsawo da ake rubutawa da maɓallin ⌨, da tsari da ke bin faɗi, tsayi da yatsa.
strings.new.v160.reports: Rahotanni masu mu'amala: jerawa, tacewa, kwafa zuwa maƙunsar bayanai, ajiye shafin a matsayin CSV da nemo abin kowane layi.
strings.new.v160.editing: Gyara: matsar da kwafa da wurin tushe, zaɓi masu kama da juna, zaɓi mai sauri, lasso da shinge, haɗa, fasa, zagaye kusurwa, yanke kusurwa a karkace, miƙa da karya.
strings.new.v160.safety: Aikinka ya fi aminci: kwafin mai binciken gizo suna zuwa IndexedDB, tagogin saituna suna da Soke na gaske, kuma maido da siga ko buɗe misali yana tambaya tukuna.
strings.new.v160.engine: Lissafi: lanƙwasar famfo ta wuraren su, tsawon bututu bisa ƙasa, tef mai daidaita matsi, na'urori a bawuloli da sabbin gargaɗin tazara da daidaito.
strings.new.v170.models: Mataimakin AI yanzu yana aiki da samfuran kamfanoni shida, da maɓallinka: Claude (Anthropic, tare da sabon Claude Fable 5.2), GPT (OpenAI, tare da GPT-6.1 Terra), Gemini (Google), Grok (xAI), Muse (Meta) ko ɗaruruwan samfura ta OpenRouter, wasu daga cikinsu kyauta. Ana zaɓar kamfanin a saitunan mataimakin.
strings.new.v170.second: Ra'ayi na biyu: maɓalli a kan amsar ƙarshe (ko /second) yana sa wani samfuri, na wani kamfani idan kana da maɓallin API ɗinsa, ya duba amsar a kan bayanan aikin; ana iya mayar da bitar ga samfurin farko.
strings.new.v170.rows: Ƙira → Ƙira ta atomatik → Layukan shuka daga hoto yana karanta fuskantarwa, tazara da adadin layukan gona daga hoton tauraron ɗan adam; daga nan rukunan gona, zoben ɗigo na gonar 'ya'yan itace da rukunan lateral suna bin su.
strings.new.v170.risk: Ƙira → Ilimin noma → Haɗarin yanayi a tsawon shekaru yana duba ƙirar a kan yanayin yau da kullum na wurin tun daga 1984: buƙatar ruwa ta shekara mai ƙarancin ruwan sama, sau nawa tsarin zai gaza, shekaru mafi muni da lokutan ɗaukewar ruwan sama.
strings.new.v170.forecast: Ƙira → Ilimin noma → Hasashen ban ruwa yana mayar da hasashen yanayi na wurin zuwa abin da za a yi ban ruwa a kwanaki masu zuwa: a yi ban ruwa ko a tsallake, zurfi, lokacin ban ruwa da kason daidaitawa % (water budget) na mai sarrafawa.
strings.new.v170.player: Ƙira → Ilimin noma → Kunna shirin a kan zane yana nuna shirin ban ruwa yana gudana a kan zanen — yankuna, kwarara, famfuna da matakin tafki a kowane lokaci — kuma yana fitar da shi a matsayin GIF mai motsi da kuma kalanda don waya.
strings.new.v170.scorecard: Ƙira → Katin makin ƙira yana ba ƙirar maki daga 0 zuwa 100 da daraja daga A zuwa E a rukunai bakwai, yana nuna abin da za a fara ingantawa kuma yana kwatanta kafin da bayan.
strings.new.v170.digitiser: Ƙira → Ɗauko lanƙwasa daga hoto yana karanta lanƙwasar famfo, lanƙwasar mai fitar da ruwa ko yanayin rarrabawar mai fesa ruwa daga jadawalin kasida zuwa kasidar aikin.
strings.new.v170.share: Hanyoyin haɗin rabawa (Fayil → Raba ta hanyar haɗi) suna sake buɗe aikin, har ma a ziyarar farko a shafin.
strings.new.v170.mcp: Ga masu haɓaka manhaja: injin lissafi yana magana da Model Context Protocol daga layin umarni (docs/MCP.md), don haka wasu manhajojin AI za su iya yin ƙira da shi.

strings.terms.title: Sharuɗɗan bayanan wasu kamfanoni
strings.terms.intro: Taswirori, tsayi, yanayi, hasashen yanayi da binciken adireshi suna fitowa daga sabis na wasu kamfanoni, kowanne da sharuɗɗansa. Takardu, PDF da rahoto suna ɗauke da yabon kowane tushe da aikin ke amfani da shi: riƙe shi idan ka miƙa ko ka wallafa aikin. Wasu sabis na kyauta don amfani ba na kasuwanci ba ne kawai; don aikin ƙwararru, yi amfani da tushen da ke kyauta ga kowane amfani ko tsarin biyan kuɗi na sabis ɗin.
strings.terms.usedNone: Babu bayanan wasu kamfanoni (tsayi na intanet, yanayi da aka sauke ko taswirar da aka riƙe don gona).
strings.terms.src.terrainTiles: Buɗaɗɗun bayanai (SRTM, GMTED, ETOPO1…) kyauta ga kowane amfani, har da na kasuwanci, tare da yabon tushen. Tushen tsayi na tsoho.
strings.terms.src.openMeteoDem: API na kyauta na Open-Meteo don amfani ba na kasuwanci ba ne kawai; amfanin kasuwanci yana buƙatar maɓallin tsarin biyan kuɗinsa. Bayanan (Copernicus DEM) suna neman yabo.
strings.terms.src.openTopoData: API na jama'a don amfani mai sauƙi ne (har zuwa buƙatu 1000 a rana, ɗaya a daƙiƙa); don amfani mai yawa, gudanar da sabarka ta kanka. Sigogin kwamfuta (desktop) kawai.
strings.terms.src.nasaPower: Bayanan NASA kyauta ga kowane amfani, har da na kasuwanci, tare da godiyar da NASA ke nema. Tushen yanayi na tsoho don aikin ƙwararru.
strings.terms.src.openMeteo: API na kyauta don amfani ba na kasuwanci ba ne kawai (har zuwa buƙatu 10 000 a rana); amfanin kasuwanci yana buƙatar maɓallin tsarin biyan kuɗinsa. Bayanan (CC BY 4.0) suna neman yabo.
strings.terms.src.nominatim: Sabis ne da masu sa kai ke gudanarwa: buƙata ɗaya a daƙiƙa a mafi yawa kuma ba amfani mai yawa ba; manhajar tana neman adireshin da ka rubuta kawai.
strings.clim.terms.nasaPower: NASA POWER: kyauta ga kowane amfani, har da aikin ƙwararru, tare da yabo.
strings.clim.terms.openMeteo: Open-Meteo: API na kyauta don amfani ba na kasuwanci ba ne kawai. Don aikin ƙwararru, yi amfani da NASA POWER (ko tsarin biyan kuɗi na Open-Meteo).

strings.agb.ph.hint: Ga kowane famfo mai amfani da lantarki: mota (IE3), lantarkinta, hanyar farawa da kebul na ciyarwa bisa ƙarfin ɗaukar lantarki (NBR 5410, Teburori 36 zuwa 40, kamar IEC 60364-5-52), bisa faɗuwar voltage yayin aiki (6.2.7) da lokacin farawa (10 % a mai farawa, 6.5.1.3.3) da kuma bisa short circuit (IEC 60909); ga samar da wuta, transformer ko janareta, lantarkin short circuit da yiwuwar rukunin farashin wuta. strings.agb.solar.title: Famfo mai hasken rana na ƙira
strings.agb.solar.hint: Ba tare da layin wuta ba: tarin faifai na watan da buƙata ta fi yawa (IEC 62253) don yawan ruwan yau da kullum na teburin buƙatar amfanin gona (ko na zanguna), ba tare da sayen makamashi ba. Haɗe da layin wuta: tarin faifai na makamashin tura ruwa na shekara, wanda ake biya kamar yadda dokar Brazil Lei 14.300/2022 ta tsara (ana biyan Fio B a kan kiredit bisa shekara). Sakamakon yana zuwa rahoto, jerin kayan aiki da kuɗin makamashin ƙira.

strings.agb.tw.title: Tsarin wayoyi biyu
strings.agb.tw.hint: Wayoyi biyu suna fita daga mai sarrafawa a tsawon hanyoyin wayoyi kuma su wuce kowane bawul; dekoda a kan wayoyin biyu yana tafiyar da bawulolin da ke cikin isar kebul na solenoid ɗinsa. Idan a kunne, ƙirar tana auna wayoyin biyu na kowane mai sarrafawa kuma jerin kayan aiki yana jera dekoda, kebul na wayoyi biyu, masu kare hauhawar wuta tare da sandunan ƙasa da mahaɗai maimakon wayoyin tasha.

strings.prb.permit.rule.deadlines: Bayyanawa na shekara (DURH) kafin 31 ga Janairu tare da bayanan wata-wata na shekarar da ta gabata; na wata-wata kafin ranar 7 ga wata na gaba; ta telemetry, ana auna aƙalla kowane minti 15 kuma ana aikawa kowace rana (Art. 6).
strings.prb.permit.rule.accuracy: Ana karɓar kuskuren da bai wuce 10 % ba na yawan ruwan da aka auna ko aka ƙiyasta (Art. 5, § 2).
strings.prb.permit.rule.records: Riƙe cikakkun bayanan aunawa na watanni 36 na ƙarshe, a buɗe ga dubawa (Art. 13).
strings.prb.permit.rule.state: Koguna da tafkunan ƙarƙashin ƙasa da ke ƙarƙashin ikon jiha suna bin ƙa'idodin hukumar ruwa ta jiha da sharuɗɗan kowane izini, waɗanda sau da yawa suke neman mitar ruwa da mai ƙidaya awanni a wurin ɗaukar ruwa da ma'aunan kowane wata.
strings.prb.permit.logNote: Cike ma'aunai a ƙarshen kowane wata; yawan ruwan da aka auna shi ne bambancin karatun mita kuma awanni na mai ƙidaya awanni. Karkacewa = (aka auna - aka bayar) / aka bayar.
strings.prb.permit.crit.volumes: Yawan ruwa: buƙata gabaɗaya ta kowane wurin ban ruwa bisa wata, bisa ƙa'idar da duk rahotanni ke amfani da ita (teburin FAO-56 na amfanin gonarsa, ma'aunin da ETo da Kc da aka rubuta, ko tsayayyen zurfin gaske bisa inganci), an haɗa su bisa tushen da ke ba wurin ruwa.
strings.prb.permit.crit.days: Tsarin aiki: kwanakin kowane wata da ke da ban ruwa da awannin da suke buƙata a kwararar da aka girka (an ƙara zuwa 0.1 h); yawan ruwan da aka bayar shi ne kwarara × awanni × kwanaki, ba ya taɓa ƙasa da buƙata.
strings.prb.permit.crit.fixedHours: Tsarin aiki: awa {h} a rana a kowane wata da kwanakin da yawan ruwan ke ɗauka; yawan ruwan da aka bayar shi ne kwarara × awanni × kwanaki, ba ya taɓa ƙasa da buƙata.
strings.prb.permit.crit.flow: Kwarara: mafi girma da tushe ke bayarwa a ƙira (ko kwararar ƙirar tushe); ana duba ƙarfin aiki a gaban watan ƙoli a cikin awa {h} a rana a mafi yawa.
