strings.prb.om.title: Shirin aiki da kulawa
strings.prb.om.emitters: Masu fitar da ruwa da tef
strings.prb.om.systemText: Wannan shiri yana tattara ayyukan aiki da kulawa na tsarin tare da alƙaluman ƙira. Ajiye tare da shi ƙirar, jerin kayan aiki da kasidun masana'antu, waɗanda suka fi tazarar lokacin da aka ba da shawara a nan rinjaye.
strings.prb.om.start.1: Duba famfo, mota da allo: alƙiblar juyawa, matsattsun haɗi, cika famfo da ruwa (priming) da tsotsa mara iska ga famfunan saman ƙasa.
strings.prb.om.start.2: Da bawulolin yankuna a rufe, cika babban bututu a hankali, da ƙaramar kwarara kuma bawuloli na iska a buɗe, har sai duk iska ta fita.
strings.prb.om.start.3: Wanke babban bututu da manifolds ta ƙarshensu a buɗe kafin a haɗa lateral, har sai ruwa ya fito da tsabta.
strings.prb.om.start.4: Yi gwajin zubewa na kowane layi a matsin teburin da ke ƙasa, ka gyara zubewa kafin a binne mahaɗai.
strings.prb.om.start.5: Buɗe yankuna ɗaya bayan ɗaya ka duba matsi bayan bawul da kuma a ƙarshen lateral idan aka kwatanta da takardar matsi; saita bawuloli na rage matsi zuwa matsinsu.
strings.prb.om.start.6: Tsara mai sarrafawa da zanguna da lokutan ban ruwa na ƙira, ka gwada kowace tasha.
strings.prb.om.start.7: Rubuta karatun farko na mitar ruwa da na mai ƙidaya awanni: su ne farkon takardar sa ido na kai.
strings.prb.om.testNote: Gwada a ninki 1.5 na mafi girman matsin aiki na layin, ba sama da ajin bututunsa mafi rauni ba (al'adar gwajin hydrostatic na hanyoyin bututun PVC, AWWA C605); tsawon lokaci da asarar da aka yarda suna bin ƙa'ida ko mai ƙera.
strings.prb.om.pressuresText: Auna da ma'aunin matsi bayan bawul ɗin yanki da kuma a ƙarshen lateral mafi rashin sa'a, yayin da yankin ke aiki; bambanci sama da 10 % yana nuna zubewa, toshewa ko saiti ba daidai ba.
strings.prb.om.emitterP: Matsi a masu fitar da ruwa (ƙarami – babba)
strings.prb.om.dutyTable: Kwarara da matsi a tushe bisa zango
strings.prb.om.flushingText: Wanke lateral a farawa, bayan kowane gyara da lokaci-lokaci (kowane wata a tsarin ɗigo, ko idan ruwan da ke ƙarshe ya fito da datti): buɗe ƙarshen lateral kaɗan a lokaci ɗaya ka bar su su gudana har sai sun yi tsabta. Gudu a ƙarshen lateral dole ya kai {v} {vu}; teburin yana bayar da kwarara da matsin da kowane yanki ke buƙata don haka.
strings.prb.om.filtersText: Wanke ko yi wa kowace matata wanke-baya (backwash) idan asarar matsinta ta tashi {d} {u} sama da asarar matatar mai tsabta, ko kafin haka idan mai ƙera ya faɗa; duba kwararar wanke-baya na matatun yashi da yanayin abubuwan raga da faifai.
strings.prb.om.noFilters: Ƙirar ba ta da matatar da aka zana: ban ruwa na kusa yana buƙatar tacewa a mashiga (na'urar kasida ta nau'in matata).
strings.prb.om.chemical: Saka chlorine da tsabtacewa da asid
strings.prb.om.chemicalText: Chlorine yana sarrafa algae da ƙwayoyin cuta da ke toshe masu fitar da ruwa; chlorine yana aiki mafi kyau idan ruwa yana ƙasa da pH 7.5, inda hypochlorous acid ke rinjaye (Nakayama da Bucks, 1986), kuma asid yana narkar da dattin carbonate. Nazarin ruwa ne ke yanke shawara ko za a tsabtace da nawa; auna chlorine mai 'yanci a ƙarshen layi mafi nisa.
strings.prb.om.chlorineTable: Allurar chlorine bisa zango (sinadari mai {p} % na chlorine da ke akwai)
strings.prb.om.chemicalSafety: Kada a taɓa haɗa asid da chlorine a tanki ɗaya ko a allura ɗaya: iskar chlorine guba ce. Sa safar hannu da gilashin kariya, ajiye sinadaran daban-daban kuma ka yi allura kafin matatu.
strings.prb.om.offSeasonText: Watannin da aka tsara ba tare da ban ruwa ba: {m}.
strings.prb.om.noOffSeason: Ƙirar tana ban ruwa duk shekara: yi waɗannan ayyuka a lokacin tsayawa mafi tsawo.
strings.prb.om.off.1: Wanke lateral da babban bututu karo na ƙarshe.
strings.prb.om.off.2: Yi tsabtacewar girgiza (chlorine ko asid, kamar yadda ruwan ke buƙata) kafin tsayawa, don kada wani biofilm ko datti ya zauna a masu fitar da ruwa.
strings.prb.om.off.3: Wanke matatu ka bar su a zubar da ruwa.
strings.prb.om.off.4: Zubar da ruwan wurare masu ƙasƙanci inda sanyi mai daskarewa zai iya zuwa.
strings.prb.om.off.5: Kare famfo da mota: zubar da ruwan cikin famfo, saka mai kamar yadda mai ƙera ya ce kuma kashe allo ko ka bar shi a bushe.
strings.prb.om.off.6: Duba bawuloli, masu daidaita matsi da masu fitar da ruwa, ka maye waɗanda suka lalace.
strings.prb.om.off.7: Rubuta karatun mitar ruwa da na mai ƙidaya awanni a ƙarshen lokacin ban ruwa.
strings.prb.om.pump.1: Kowane wata a lokacin ban ruwa: lantarkin mota idan aka kwatanta da farantin bayanai, hayaniya, girgiza, zubewa da zafi.
strings.prb.om.pump.2: Karanta mai ƙidaya awanni ka kwatanta awannin da waɗanda aka tsara.
strings.prb.om.pump.3: Duba matsin fita da kwarara a wurin aikin ƙira; ƙarancin kwarara a matsi iri ɗaya yana nuna lalacewa ko toshewar tsotsa.
strings.prb.om.pump.4: Sau ɗaya a shekara, a lokacin hutu: bearings, hatimi ko packing, daidaituwa da rufin wayar mota.
strings.prb.om.valve.1: Bawulolin yankuna: suna buɗewa da rufewa gaba ɗaya, ba tare da kwarara a ƙasa ba idan a rufe.
strings.prb.om.valve.2: Bawuloli na iska ({n} a ƙira): wanke su ka duba fitar iska a farkon lokacin ban ruwa.
strings.prb.om.valve.2none: Bawuloli na iska: ƙirar ba ta da wanda aka zana; duba wurare masu tsayi na babban bututu (Babban bututu → Bawuloli na iska).
strings.prb.om.valve.3: Masu daidaita matsi da bawuloli na ragewa: duba saitunan teburin.
strings.prb.om.controller.1: Mai sarrafawa: batir, kwanan wata da lokaci, na'urorin gane ruwan sama da shirin wata (lokutan ban ruwa suna bin buƙatar kowane wata).
strings.prb.om.controller.2: Wayoyi: voltage a solenoids yayin da bawuloli da yawa ke buɗe, mahaɗai a bushe kuma a rufe.

strings.prb.bud.compositionsText: Kowane ɗan ƙungiyar aiki yana aiki awa {h} a rana; ma'aunin shi ne awannin kowane abin aiki ga kowace naúrar aiki (awannin ƙungiya a rana bisa abin da ƙungiyar ke samarwa a rana, wanda yake na jadawalin gini).

strings.prb.bud.resourcesNote: Kuɗin tunani ƙimomin misali ne na farawa a kuɗin reais na Brazil, an canza su a ƙimar musayar tunani: maye su da na teburin kuɗi na hukuma na yankinka da kwanan wata (SINAPI a Brazil), tare da nauyin zamantakewa na ladar aiki da mai aiki da mai na injuna.

strings.prb.lcc.title: Kuɗin tsawon rai na madadi
strings.prb.lcc.methodText: Kowane madadi yana haɗa jari, maye kowane sashe a ƙarshen rayuwarsa, makamashi, ruwa da kulawa ta shekara a tsawon lokacin nazarin, a cire ƙimar da ta rage a sassan a ƙarshe, duka an kawo su zuwa ƙimar yanzu a ƙimar rangwame.
strings.prb.lcc.escalation: Hauhawar farashin makamashi na gaske a shekara
strings.prb.lcc.categories: Tsawon rai da kulawa bisa rukuni
strings.prb.lcc.other: Sauran (jari ba tare da jerin kayan aiki ba)
strings.prb.lcc.refs: Nassoshi: bututun layi shekaru 25 da sassan inji da na musamman (famfuna, motoci, pivots, bututun ɗigo) shekaru 15 (Goulburn Broken CMA, 2015); masu fesa ruwa da ɗigo shekaru 10 da kulawa ta shekara ta 1 % (masu fesa ruwa na dindindin) zuwa 5 % (pivots da ɗigo na saman ƙasa) na jari (ARC Irrigation User's Manual, kamar yadda SASRI ta ambata, 2023). Daidaita su da bayanan mai ƙera da gogewar wurin.
strings.prb.lcc.none: Babu madadi mai sakamako: yi lissafin ƙira (F5) ko ajiye madadi (Ƙira → Madadin ƙira).

strings.ai.key.explain.google: Samfuran Gemini suna aiki da maɓallin API na Gemini naka, daga Google: Google yana cajin kuɗin amfani a asusunka. Samfuran Flash suna da ajin kyauta mai iyakoki, inda Google zai iya amfani da abun ciki don inganta kayayyakinsa. Ƙirƙiri maɓalli a Google AI Studio.
strings.ai.key.explain.xai: Samfuran Grok suna aiki a kan asusunka na xAI: xAI yana cajin kuɗin amfani a wannan asusun. Ƙirƙiri maɓalli a console na xAI.
strings.ai.key.explain.meta: Samfuran Muse suna aiki a kan asusunka na Meta Model API: Meta yana cajin kuɗin amfani a wannan asusun. Ƙirƙiri maɓalli a dandalin masu haɓaka manhaja na Meta.
strings.ai.key.explain.openrouter: Maɓallin OpenRouter ɗaya yana kaiwa ga samfuran kamfanoni da yawa (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, Muse da ɗaruruwan wasu, wasu daga cikinsu kyauta): OpenRouter yana cajin kuɗin amfani daga kiredit ɗinka kuma yana miƙa kowace buƙata ga kamfanin da ke gudanar da samfurin. Ƙirƙiri maɓalli a shafin OpenRouter.
strings.ai.model.freeHint: Wannan samfurin yana da ajin kyauta, mai iyakokin da kamfaninsa ya saita; a cikinsa, kamfanin zai iya amfani da abin da aka aika don inganta kayayyakinsa (duba sharuɗɗansa). Farashin da ke sama na amfani da ake biya ne.

strings.scr.title: Katin makin ƙira
strings.scr.hint: Ingancin ƙirar a shafi ɗaya: kowace manuniya tana fitowa daga sakamako, dubawa da nazarce-nazarcen shirin, tare da manufarta da tushenta a gefenta. Idan babu bayanai, manuniyar tana zama a wajen matsakaici.
strings.scr.needDesign: Fara yin ƙirar aikin (Ƙira → Ƙirƙiri duka, F5): katin maki yana karanta sakamakon ƙira.
strings.scr.busy: Ana gudanar da ƙira; katin maki zai bayyana idan ta ƙare.
strings.scr.improvements: Abin da za a fara ingantawa
strings.scr.nothing: Babu abin da za a inganta a manuniyoyin da aka tantance.
strings.scr.method: Ana ba kowace manuniya maki daga 0 zuwa 100 ta dabarar layi madaidaici gunduwa-gunduwa (piecewise-linear) tsakanin wuraren ma'auni da aka ɗauko daga ƙa'ida ko nassin da ke gefenta: EU (ajujuwan ASABE EP405.1) 70 → 60, 80 → 70, 90 → 80, 94 → 90, 100 → 100; CU na haɗuwa 75 → 60, 85 → 80, 100 → 100; q_var 0 → 100, 10 → 90, 20 → 70, 100 → 0; sharaɗin da dole ya cika a ko'ina yana samun kason da ya cika shi; ƙidayar da dole ta zama sifili tana samun 100 a sifili da 0 in ba haka ba. Rukuni shi ne matsakaicin manuniyoyinsa da aka tantance, kuma jimillar maki ita ce matsakaicin rukunan da aka tantance, kowanne da nauyi iri ɗaya (1). Daraja: A ≥ 90, B ≥ 80, C ≥ 70, D ≥ 60, E ƙasa da haka. Manuniya mara bayanai ana barin ta a wajen matsakaita, ba a taɓa zato ba; wadda ba ta da manufar ma'auni ana bayar da rahotonta kawai. Makin da za a samu su ne yawan da jimillar maki za ta ƙaru idan wannan manuniya ta kai 100.

strings.scr.h.eu: Rage bambancin da aka yarda a yanki (Sigogin ƙira) ka sake yin ƙira, ko yi amfani da masu fitar da ruwa masu daidaita matsi, gajerun laterals ko ƙarin masu fitar da ruwa ga kowace shuka.
strings.scr.h.cu: Kusantar da masu fesa ruwa (50–60 % na diamitar jiƙa a tsakaninsu) ko daidaita bakunan fesawarsu; Densogram yana nuna wuraren da suka bushe.
strings.scr.h.qvar: Ƙaramin bambancin da aka yarda (Sigogin ƙira), manyan laterals ko masu fitar da ruwa masu daidaita matsi suna rage bambancin kwarara.
strings.scr.h.velocity: Gyara kai tsaye yana barin ƙira ta auna girman bututun da suka wuce iyaka; ko zaɓi manyan bututu.
strings.scr.h.pipeClass: Gyara kai tsaye yana ɗaga ajin bututun da suka wuce ƙimar matsinsu.
strings.scr.h.window: Sake yin ƙira tare da buɗe bututu (Gyara kai tsaye), ko raba yankin zuwa zirrai masu kusan tsayi ɗaya (iyakokinsu su bi layukan tsayi).
strings.scr.h.valvePressure: Zaɓi famfo don wurin aiki (Zaɓi famfo) ko ka bar ƙira ta lissafa matsin tushe.
strings.scr.h.pumpRange: Zaɓi famfo wanda lanƙwasarsa ta rufe kowane zango (Zaɓi famfo).
strings.scr.h.pumpBep: Zaɓi famfo wanda mafi kyawun ingancinsa ke kusa da wurin aiki, ko haɗa yankunan ta yadda kwararar su za ta yi kama da juna.
strings.scr.h.headUse: Famfo mai ƙaramin tsayi, impeller da aka rage, ko mai canza mitar wuta mai matsin manufa yana adana tsayin da bawuloli ke ɓatarwa (Zaɓi famfo).
strings.scr.h.rateIntake: Yi amfani da ƙananan bakunan fesawa ko tazara mafi faɗi, ko zagaye da hutun shan ruwa (Ilimin noma → Shirin ban ruwa).
strings.scr.h.runoff: Zagaye da hutun shan ruwa (Shirin ban ruwa), ƙaramin zurfi ga kowane taro ko, a pivot, mai ƙidaya lokaci mai sauri.
strings.scr.h.capacity: Gudanar da ƙarin yankuna a lokaci ɗaya (Zanguna), faɗaɗa tagar ban ruwa ko ƙara tushen ruwa.
strings.scr.h.lccRank: Wani madadi yana da ƙarancin kuɗi a tsawon rayuwarsa: kwatanta su a Kuɗin tsawon rai.
strings.scr.h.surge: Rufe bawuloli a hankali (Sigogin ƙira, lokacin rufewa) ko ɗaga ajin bututu (Gyara kai tsaye).
strings.scr.h.suction: Sanya famfo ƙasa ko kusa da ruwa, faɗaɗa bututun tsotsarsa ko yi amfani da famfon nutsewa.
strings.scr.h.agedWindow: Bar ƙarin ratar matsi, kuma ka tace ka wanke laterals don masu fitar da ruwa su rage tsufa.
strings.scr.h.agedEu: Tacewa, wankewa da tsabtace ruwa suna sa masu fitar da ruwa su kasance masu tsabta; masu fitar da ruwa masu daidaita matsi suna riƙe kwararar su.

strings.fct.title: Hasashen ban ruwa na kwanaki masu zuwa
strings.fct.hint: Yana ɗauko hasashen yanayi na wurin kuma yana faɗa, ga kowane wurin ban ruwa, a waɗanne daga cikin kwanaki masu zuwa za a yi ban ruwa, da wane zurfi da kuma tsawon wane lokaci (a ƙimar zubawa ta ƙirar), da daidaitawa a % na shirin ƙira — lambar da ake rubutawa a mai sarrafawa (water budget). Ba a ɗauko komai sai ka nema.

strings.fct.etoBy.pm: ETo ta dabarar FAO Penman-Monteith, an ƙiyasta hasken rana daga kewayon zafi (FAO-56, eq. 50): sabis ɗin ba ya bayar da hasken rana.
strings.fct.assume: Hasashe ba tabbas ba ne, musamman bayan kwanaki uku na farko: duba shi kafin ban ruwa kuma ka sake ɗauko shi gobe. Ana ɗaukar ƙasa kamar yadda ka faɗa a farko (babu ruwan sama tun ban ruwa na ƙarshe) kuma babu ruwan sama bayan ranar ƙarshe ta hasashen. Ruwan sama ƙasa da 0.2·ETo na ranar ba a ƙidaya shi; abin da ya wuce ƙarfin riƙe ruwan ƙasa (field capacity) yana zurarewa ƙasa. Ana yin ban ruwa ga wuri idan ƙasa ta rasa abin da taron shiri ɗaya ke maye gurbinsa (ko ruwan da ke samuwa cikin sauƙi, idan ya fi ƙanƙanta), ana cike abin da ya rage. Daidaitawar (%) ita ce ruwan da amfanin gona ke amfani da shi ban da ruwan sama da ƙasa ke riƙewa, a kan abin da shirin ƙira ke zubawa a kwanaki iri ɗaya.

strings.terms.src.metNorway: Bayanai a buɗe na Cibiyar Nazarin Yanayi ta Norway (CC BY 4.0), kyauta ga kowane amfani, har da na kasuwanci, tare da yabo. Manhajar tana neman hasashen ne kawai idan ka nema, da daidaitawar wurin, kuma ba ta sake nema kafin lokacin da sabis ɗin ya bayar. Shi ne tushen hasashe na tsoho.

strings.row.hint: Yana karanta fuskantarwa da tazarar layukan gonar 'ya'yan itace, kofi, inabi ko lemu a kan hoton tauraron ɗan adam (ko a kan hoton sama da ke cikin zane), don shimfiɗa laterals a tsawon layukan da ke gona tuni. Ana sarrafa hoton a wannan na'ura, ba tare da buƙatar mataimakin AI ba.
strings.row.noArea: Zaɓi wurin ban ruwa (ko rufaffiyar iyaka) na gonar da aka shuka sannan ka sake buɗe wannan kayan aiki.
strings.row.noImagery: Hoton tauraron ɗan adam bai loda a nan ba (babu intanet, ko babu hotuna a wannan yanki).
strings.row.conf.uncertain: {p} % — babu tabbas: duba layukan a kan hoton
strings.row.detail: Dalla-dalla a tsakiya, pikisal na ainihi
strings.row.otherBand: Layuka a ɗayan ratsin (rabin tazara gefe)
strings.row.otherBandHint: Idan layukan da aka gano sun faɗa a hanyoyin tsakanin layukan shuka (inuwa, ciyawar rufe ƙasa) maimakon a kan shuke-shuke, kunna wannan don matsar da su rabin tazara.
strings.row.apply.rows: Fuskantar layuka da tazara a kan wurin (ana amfani da su wajen raba gona zuwa rukunai, a zoben ɗigo na gonar 'ya'yan itace da a rukunin lateral)
strings.row.apply.guides: Layukan jagora na layukan shuka a layer ɗin {l}
strings.row.areaOnly: Wannan iyaka ba wurin ban ruwa ba ce: layukan jagora kawai za a iya zana.
strings.row.applied: An aiwatar da layuka: {d}°, {s}; layukan jagora {n}.
strings.row.fromArea: Fuskantar layuka da tazara da aka karanta daga hoton don wannan wuri.
strings.row.msg.noField: Iyakar ba ta kewaye kowane wuri ba.
strings.row.msg.noPixels: Hoton ba shi da bayanai a cikin iyakar.
strings.row.msg.tooSmall: Gonar ta yi ƙanƙanta ga layuka daga {s}: faɗaɗa iyakar ko rage tazara mafi faɗi.
strings.row.msg.flat: Hoton ba ya nuna bambancin haske a cikin gonar.
strings.row.msg.noRows: Babu layukan da ake gani: ƙasa babu shuka, makiyaya, rufin ganye a haɗe ko layuka a wajen kewayon tazara.
strings.row.msg.coarse: Hoton yana da {r} a kowane pikisal: ba za a iya ganin layukan da suka fi kusa da {s} a cikinsa ba.
strings.row.msg.curved: Layukan suna lanƙwasa ko canza alƙibla a cikin gonar: fuskantarwar matsakaici ce; raba gonar zuwa sassa madaidaita.
strings.row.msg.fewRows: Layuka {n} kawai a faɗin gonar: karatu mai rauni.
strings.row.msg.fewPixels: Pikisal {p} kawai na hoton a kowace tazara: duba shi a kan hoton.
strings.row.msg.window: Babbar gona: an karanta taga ta {a} × {b} a tsakiyarta kuma an faɗaɗa layukan zuwa duk gonar.
strings.ai.op.detect_crop_rows: Karanta layukan shuka a kan hoton
strings.ai.op.apply_crop_rows: Aiwatar da layukan shuka da aka karanta a kan hoton
strings.clr.title: Haɗarin yanayi a tsawon shekaru
strings.clr.hint: Yadda tsarin, kamar yadda aka ƙirƙira shi, zai yi a kowace daga cikin shekarun gaske na baya-bayan nan: ma'aunin ruwa na yau da kullum na kowane wuri da jerin yanayin yau da kullum na wurin, ba tare da iyaka ba da kuma da ƙarfin aikin tsarin. Yana nuna yadda buƙatar ban ruwa da buƙatar ƙoli suka bambanta, dogaro, shekaru mafi muni da alƙiblar sauyi, kusa da alƙaluman da ƙirar ke amfani da su.
strings.clr.noAreas: Babu wurin ban ruwa mai ma'aunin ruwa (amfanin gona, ko ETo da Kc). Zana wuri ka zaɓi amfanin gonarsa.
strings.clr.src.nasaPower: NASA POWER, {a}–{b} (yana sauke MB kaɗan sau ɗaya kuma yana ajiye su a wannan na'ura)
strings.clr.saved: An riƙe haɗarin yanayi a cikin aikin (taƙaitawa kawai).
strings.clr.stored: An lissafa a {d} da {s}, {a}–{b}. Sake gudanar da shi bayan canza ƙirar.
strings.clr.capacityUnknown: ba a san ƙarfin aiki ba (babu masu fitar da ruwa a wurin, ko a wajen zanguna)
strings.clr.designEto: ba a wuce shi ba a {p} % na shekaru: {v}; ƙirar tana amfani da {w}
strings.clr.designPeak: ba a wuce shi ba a {p} % na shekaru: {v}; ƙirar tana amfani da {w}; ƙarfin aiki {c}
strings.clr.exceeded: an wuce shi a shekaru {k} cikin {n}
strings.clr.reliability: shekaru {k} cikin {n} ba tare da ranar gibi ba ({p} %)
strings.clr.trend.title: Alƙiblar sauyi
strings.clr.trend: {v} a kowace shekara goma (gangaren Sen; gwajin Mann-Kendall a 5 %: {s})
strings.clr.q.gross: Zurfin ban ruwa gabaɗaya da ake buƙata a shekara
strings.clr.q.volume: Yawan ruwa gabaɗaya da ake buƙata a shekara
strings.clr.q.pumped: Yawan ruwan da aka tura a shekara (da ƙarfin aiki)
strings.clr.q.deficit: Kwanakin da suka wuce raguwar da aka yarda
strings.clr.reanalysis: Bayanan sake nazari (reanalysis; NASA POWER: MERRA-2 a kan sel na kusan km 50) suna sassauta matsanancin yanayi na wurin: tasha a wurin na iya nuna ƙolin ETo mafi girma da ɗaukewar ruwan sama mafi tsawo. Alƙaluman nuni ne, ba garanti ba.
strings.clr.method: Hanya: ETo na Penman-Monteith na yau da kullum da ma'aunin ruwan ƙasa na FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998, babi 8); yuwuwa da matsayin Weibull i/(n+1); alƙiblar sauyi ta gangaren Sen da gwajin Mann-Kendall; ɗaukewar ruwan sama = kwanaki a jere masu ruwan sama ƙasa da mm 1 (ma'aunin CDD na ETCCDI). Kwanakin da babu bayanai: matsakaicin ETo na watan kuma babu ruwan sama; ana barin shekarun da fiye da 10 % na bayanansu suka ɓace.
strings.clr.w.clr_short: Ƙasa da cikakkun shekaru 10: yuwuwa da alƙiblar sauyi ba su da ƙarfi.
strings.clr.w.clr_no_eto: Jerin ba shi da ETo (babu bayanan zafi).
strings.clr.w.clr_no_areas: Babu wurin da ke da ma'aunin ruwa.
strings.clr.w.clr_fixed: {n}: tsayayyen zurfi na yau da kullum, babu ma'aunin ruwa; an bar shi.
strings.clr.w.clr_rainfed: {n}: ma'aunin da aka ajiye na ruwan sama kawai ne (rainfed); an tantance shi ana ban ruwa a raguwar da aka yarda.
strings.clr.w.clr_cycles: {n}: zagayen amfanin gona na farko kawai ake tantancewa.
strings.clr.w.clr_no_capacity: {n}: ba a san ƙarfin aikin tsarin ba; dogaron yana nuna shirin ne kawai.
strings.clr.w.clr_no_seasons: {n}: jerin bai rufe wani cikakken lokacin noma ba.
strings.clr.err.clr_no_areas: Babu abin da za a yi nazari: babu wurin da ke da ma'aunin ruwa.
strings.clr.err.clr_no_series: Yanayin wurin ba shi da jerin yau da kullum: sauke shi a Ƙira → Yanayin wurin, ko yi amfani da NASA POWER.
strings.clr.err.clr_busy: Ana gudanar da ƙira; jira har ta ƙare.
strings.clr.ai.op: Yi nazarin haɗarin yanayi a tsawon shekaru

tutorial.Moves on by itself when done (click to t: Yana ci gaba da kansa idan an gama (danna don kashewa)
tutorial.Auto-advance off (click to turn on): Ci gaba ta atomatik a kashe (danna don kunnawa)
tutorial.Continue where you stopped: {c}, step {i: Ci gaba daga inda ka tsaya: {c}, mataki {i}
tutorial.On a phone? Take the short track for tou: A waya kake? Bi gajeriyar hanya don allon taɓawa
tutorial.On a phone or tablet: the menus are unde: A waya ko kwamfutar hannu: menus suna ƙarƙashin ☰, allon maɓalli shi ne maɓallin ⌨ kuma “Nuna mini” yana yi maka matakin.
tutorial.You can reopen this tutorial from Help →: Za ka iya sake buɗe wannan koyarwa daga Taimako → Koyarwa mai mu'amala. Ƙira mai daɗi!
tutorial.Menus at the top, tool palette on the le: Menus a sama, faifan kayan aiki a hagu, zanen CAD a tsakiya, kaddarori da layers a dama, mashayar matsayi a ƙasa. Koyarwar ta buɗe gonar 'ya'yan itace ta misali mai toshe biyu a shafinta na kanta: abin da ka yi a nan ba ya canza ayyukanka, waɗanda ke nan a sauran shafuka. Kowane ƙira yana farawa daga wurin: da farko za ka gano inda gonar take, ka sa taswirar tauraron ɗan adam ƙarƙashin zanen, sannan ka sauke yanayin ƙasa daga intanet. Kowane mataki na wannan koyarwar yana neman aiki kuma yana gane lokacin da ka yi shi; “Nuna mini” yana yi maka.
tutorial.The mouse wheel zooms around the cursor;: Ƙafar linzami tana ƙara girma kewaye da siginan linzami; + da − ma. A waya, matse.
tutorial.Roll the mouse wheel over the drawing: Juya ƙafar linzami a kan zane
tutorial.Drag with the middle or right button, ho: Ja da maɓallin tsakiya ko na dama, riƙe Space ka ja, ko yi amfani da maɓallan kibiya.
tutorial.Pan by dragging with the right button: Motsa kallo ta hanyar ja da maɓallin dama
tutorial.Home (or the alias Z, or View → Zoom all: Home (ko gajeriyar Z, ko Kallo → Nuna duka) yana nuna duka ƙirar.
tutorial.With the Select tool (Esc returns to it): Da kayan aikin Zaɓi (Esc yana komawa gare shi), danna wani abu. Shift yana ƙarawa zaɓi.
tutorial.Click a valve (orange triangle) or a pip: Danna bawul (triangle mai launin lemu) ko bututu
tutorial.Drag left to right for fully enclosed ob: Ja daga hagu zuwa dama don abubuwan da ke cikin taga gaba ɗaya; dama zuwa hagu don duk abin da taga ta ƙetare.
tutorial.Drag a window over a block (3 objects or: Ja taga a kan rukuni (abubuwa 3 ko fiye)
tutorial.Drag a selected object to move it. With: Ja abin da aka zaɓa don motsa shi. Da abu ɗaya da aka zaɓa, maƙallai suna bayyana: ja kusurwa, ja maƙallin tsakiya don saka kusurwa, Ctrl + danna yana cire ɗaya.
tutorial.Ctrl+Z undoes (or the alias U), Ctrl+Y r: Ctrl+Z yana warwarewa (ko gajeriyar U), Ctrl+Y yana sake yi. Kowane gyara, har da aunawa, ana iya warwarewa.
tutorial.The History tab, next to Properties and: Shafin Tarihi, kusa da Kaddarori da Layuka, yana jera kowane aiki tun lokacin da aka buɗe fayil, irin na Photoshop. Danna mataki don komawa baya (ko gaba) gare shi; matakan gaba suna zama launin toka kuma ana iya sake yin su har sai sabon gyara ya watsar da su. Ctrl+Z da Ctrl+Y suna motsa mataki ɗaya a lokaci ɗaya.
tutorial.Whatever is selected is edited here: nam: Duk abin da aka zaɓa ana gyara shi a nan: suna, layer, bututu ("Ta atomatik" yana bar shirin ya auna shi), emitter, matsi, tazara, bawul, tushe, famfo… Bayan ƙira, sashin Sakamako yana nuna gudanar ruwa, gudu da matsi na abu.
tutorial.Del deletes the selection (or the alias: Del yana goge zaɓi (ko gajeriyar E). Ctrl+Z yana dawo da shi.
tutorial.Select something and press Del: Zaɓi wani abu ka danna Del
tutorial.Ctrl+D duplicates the selection beside i: Ctrl+D yana ninka zaɓi kusa da kansa. Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V suna kwafa, yanke da manna, har ma tsakanin shafukan ayyuka. Gyara → Jeri yana maimaita zaɓi a layuka da ginshiƙai.
tutorial.The Layers tab groups the objects (zone: Shafin Layuka yana haɗa abubuwa a rukuni (bututun yanki, babban bututu, emitters, radius na jiƙa, layukan tsayi, wurare, lakabi…): kowane layer yana da launi, bayyana da makulli, kuma yana nuna adadin abubuwan da ke cikinsa.
tutorial.The eye of each layer hides its objects;: Idon kowane layer yana ɓoye abubuwansa; makullin yana hana gyara. Yana da amfani don tsaftace allo kafin bugawa.
tutorial.Hide the Wetted radii layer: Ɓoye layer na Radius na jiƙa
tutorial.Snap locks the cursor onto nodes, endpoi: Kamawa yana kulle siginan linzami a kan mahaɗai, ƙarshen layi, tsakiya da kan bututu: haka emitters da bawuloli ke haɗuwa da bututu. Grid (F9) yana kama kan ninkin grid; F7 yana nuna grid.
tutorial.Press F3 (or click Snap in the status ba: Danna F3 (ko danna Kamawa a mashaya matsayi) don canzawa
tutorial.Ortho locks every segment to horizontal: Ortho yana kulle kowane sashi a kwance ko tsaye, kamar a shirye-shiryen CAD. Bar shi a kunne don zana bututu masu daidaito.
tutorial.Line, polyline, rectangle, circle, arc,: Layi, polyline, murabba'i, da'ira, baka, spline, zane-zane, rubutu da ma'auni suna zana bayan ƙirar (iyakoki, hanyoyi, gine-gine). Zaɓe su a cikin palette, menu na Zana ko ta rubuta gajeriya.
tutorial.Pick Line (L) and click two points: Zaɓi Layi (L) ka danna wurare biyu
tutorial.As in Photoshop: hold Shift while drawin: Kamar a Photoshop: riƙe Shift yayin zana kuma sashin yana kullewa a 0°, 45° ko 90° daga wurin da ya gabata. Mashaya matsayi tana nuna [45°].
tutorial.With Line active, click a point and, hol: Da Layi yana aiki, danna wuri kuma, riƙe da Shift, danna na biyu
tutorial.Click the vertices; Enter or double-clic: Danna kusurwoyi; Enter ko danna sau biyu yana ƙarewa, Backspace yana cire wuri na ƙarshe, Esc yana sokewa.
tutorial.Type PL, click three points and press En: Rubuta PL, danna wurare uku ka danna Enter
tutorial.Circle (C): centre and a point on the ra: Da'ira (C): tsakiya da wuri a kan radius. Murabba'i (REC): kusurwoyi biyu masu fuskantar juna.
tutorial.Type C and click the centre and the radi: Rubuta C ka danna tsakiya da radius
tutorial.Text (T): click the point and type; heig: Rubutu (T): danna wuri ka rubuta; tsayi da juyawa suna cikin kaddarori. Lakabin gudanar ruwa da matsi ana samar da su ta atomatik bayan ƙira.
tutorial.Type T, click the drawing and write a te: Rubuta T, danna zane ka rubuta rubutu
tutorial.Dimension (D): two points and the dimens: Ma'auni (D): wurare biyu da wurin layin ma'auni; akwai ma'aunin kusurwa (DAN) da na radius (DRA). Auna (ME) yana nuna nisa da faɗi ba tare da ƙirƙirar komai ba.
tutorial.Type D and click two points and the dime: Rubuta D ka danna wurare biyu da wurin ma'auni
tutorial.With the drawing focused, type the alias: Da zanen yana da hankali, rubuta gajeriya kamar a shirye-shiryen CAD (L, PL, C, REC, ZP, MP, SL, V, WS…) da Enter ko Space; bayan ɗan dakata yana gudana da kansa. Mashaya matsayi tana nuna umarni da abin da zai yi. Taimako → Gajerun hanyoyi yana jera su duka.
tutorial.The editing group of the palette (or RO,: Rukunin gyara na palette (ko RO, MI, SC, O, TR, EX, CUT) yana juyawa, madubi, ma'auni, gusarwa, datsewa, tsawaitawa da yanke bututun zaɓi. Saka bawul, mahaɗi, famfo ko na'ura a kan bututu yana raba shi a wurin.
tutorial.Contours and spot heights form the digit: Layukan tsayi da wuraren tsayi suna samar da samfurin ƙasa na dijital (triangulation): tsayin kowane bututu da emitter ana ƙididdige shi daga gare su kuma yana shiga lissafin matsi. Kowane layi yana haɗa wurare masu tsayi ɗaya: idan ka gama (Enter) taga tana tambayar tsayi kuma tana shirya layi na gaba ta ƙara tazara (misali 100, 101, 102 m). Za ka iya kuma shigo da DXF, wuraren CSV ko sauke tsayi daga intanet (Ƙira → Ƙasa).
tutorial.Type CT, click the contour points, Enter: Rubuta CT, danna wuraren layin tsayi, Enter ka tabbatar da tsayi
tutorial.A spot height (SP) fixes the elevation a: Wurin tsayi (SP) yana tsayar da tsayi a wuri ɗaya: rijiya, gidan famfo, kusurwoyin gona. Ana tambayar tsayi a kowane dannawa (kashe shi a kaddarorin kayan aiki don sake amfani da ƙima ɗaya). Ƙira → Ƙasa → Kallon 3D yana nuna samfurin da aka samu kuma Samar da layukan tsayi yana zana layukan samfurin.
tutorial.Type SP, click a point and give the elev: Rubuta SP, danna wuri ka ba da tsayi
tutorial.Elevation from the internet and model co: Tsayi daga intanet da layukan samfuri
tutorial.Design → Terrain gathers the relief tool: Ƙira → Ƙasa yana tattara kayan aikin ƙasa: Sauke tsayi daga intanet yana ƙirƙirar grid na wuraren tsayi daga samfurin tsayin ƙasa na jama'a (yana buƙatar matsayin wuri a Fayil → Matsayin wuri); Samar da layukan tsayi yana zana layuka daga samfuri; Ƙididdiga tana zaɓar triangulation (DTM) ko nisa ta juye; Share bayanin tsayi yana cire hanyar shunayya.
tutorial.The Area tool (AR) defines polygons with: Kayan aikin Wuri (AR) yana ƙayyade polygons da zurfin ruwa na gaske da inganci: rahoton Buƙatun ruwa yana lissafa girma da lokacin ban ruwa ga kowane wuri daga emitters da ke cikinsa.
tutorial.Type AR, click the corners of an area an: Rubuta AR, danna kusurwoyin wuri da Enter
tutorial.Every network starts at a supply (well,: Kowace hanyar sadarwa tana farawa a tushe (rijiya, tanki, ruwan gari). Shigar da matsi da gudanar ruwa da ke akwai, ko bar "Lissafa matsi" don shirin ya faɗi abin da tushen dole ya bayar.
tutorial.Type WS and click where the supply is: Rubuta WS ka danna inda tushen yake
tutorial.Mainline pipe (MP): draw from the supply: Babban bututu (MP): zana daga tushe zuwa inda bawuloli za su kasance. Abubuwan babban bututu suna haɗuwa da abubuwan babban bututu kawai; diamita na iya zama tsayayye ko "Ta atomatik".
tutorial.Type MP and draw a pipe from the new sup: Rubuta MP ka zana bututu daga sabon tushe
tutorial.Pump (PU) and devices (F: filter, meter,: Famfo (PU) da na'urori (F: tace, mita, PRV, bawul na ƙofa, bawul na iska) ana saka su a kan babban bututu, wanda ake raba a wurin. Lanƙwasar famfo tana zuwa daga kasida; Babban bututu → Zaɓi famfo yana jera famfo don wurin aiki.
tutorial.Type PU and click on the mainline pipe: Rubuta PU ka danna kan babban bututu
tutorial.The valve (V) separates each zone from t: Bawul (V) yana raba kowane yanki daga babban bututu: haɗa shi a ƙarshen babban bututu. Manifold, laterals da emitters suna rataye a gefen yanki.
tutorial.Type V and click at the end of the mainl: Rubuta V ka danna ƙarshen babban bututu
tutorial.Zone pipe (ZP): downstream of the valve,: Bututun yanki (ZP): bayan bawul, zana manifold da ke ciyar da laterals.
tutorial.Type ZP and draw a pipe from the valve: Rubuta ZP ka zana bututu daga bawul
tutorial.Sprayline (SL) creates a pipe with equal: Layin fesa ruwa (SL) yana ƙirƙirar bututu mai emitters masu tazara ɗaya; Tef (DT) yana ƙirƙirar tef ɗin ɗigo da bayanan kasida. Emitter, bakin fesawa, matsin da aka ƙayyade da tazara suna cikin kaddarori; matsin da aka ƙayyade da haƙuri suna ƙayyade tagar matsin da aka yarda na yanki.
tutorial.Type SL and draw a lateral from the subm: Rubuta SL ka zana lateral daga manifold
tutorial.Outlet (EM) places a sprinkler or emitte: Emitter (EM) yana sanya mai fesa ruwa ko emitter a kan bututun yanki; radius na jiƙa yana bayyana a layer na Radius na jiƙa. Kasida tana da ƙananan masu fesa ruwa, masu fesa ruwa na bugu, bindigogi da masu ɗigo.
tutorial.Type EM and click on the submain: Rubuta EM ka danna kan manifold
tutorial.Block (B): click the field corners, Ente: Rukuni (B): danna kusurwoyin gona, Enter, sannan zaɓi nau'i (ƙaramin fesa ruwa ko ɗigo), emitter, tazara, fuskantarwa, wurin manifold da bawul: shirin yana samar da laterals, manifold, guntu da bawul. Hanya mafi sauri ta gina yanki.
tutorial.Type B, click four corners, Enter and co: Rubuta B, danna kusurwoyi huɗu, Enter ka tabbatar da tattaunawa
tutorial.Grid (AH): fills a polygon with sprinkle: Grid (AH): yana cika polygon da masu fesa ruwa a tsarin murabba'i ko triangular daga tazara ko radius na jiƙa, don a haɗa su da bututun yanki daga baya.
tutorial.Type AH, click the corners of an area, E: Rubuta AH, danna kusurwoyin wuri, Enter ka tabbatar
tutorial.Design → Parameters: head-loss formula (: Ƙira → Sigogi: dabarar asarar matsi (Hazen-Williams ko Darcy-Weisbach), zafi, gudu mafi girma, ƙananan asara, riba, tsawon lokaci, kuɗin makamashi da awanni/shekara don daidaita kuɗin bututu da kuɗin famfo. Ƙira → Kasida: bututu, emitters, tef, bawuloli da famfo masu farashi; gyara ko kashe abubuwa.
tutorial.Design → Design check (CHK) sweeps the d: Ƙira → Duba ƙira (CHK) yana bincika zane don matsaloli: abubuwan da ba a haɗa ba (ja a zane), bututun da ke ƙetare juna ba tare da mahaɗi ba, ƙarshen matattu, yankuna ba tare da emitters ba, kwafi, samfuran kasida da suka ɓace da hanyoyin sadarwa masu zagaye. Danna abu a jerin don gano shi ka gyara shi ta motsa shi da kamawa a kan bututu.
tutorial.Run the check (Design menu or CHK): Gudanar da duba (menu na Ƙira ko CHK)
tutorial.▶ or F5 runs the full cycle: sizes each: ▶ ko F5 yana gudanar da cikakken zagaye: yana auna bututun atomatik na kowane yanki bisa tagar matsi da la'akari da tattalin arziki, yana saita matsin bawuloli, yana lissafa babban bututu ga kowane zango, abin da tushe dole ya bayar, wankewa, bugun ruwa da jerin kayan aiki. Lissafi yana gudana a baya da panel na ci gaba.
tutorial.After the design, pipes are coloured by: Bayan ƙira, bututu suna da launi bisa gudu (shuɗi → kore → lemu → ja sama da iyaka), bawuloli da tushe suna nuna gudanar ruwa da matsi, kuma bututu suna nuna gudanar ruwa/gudu idan an ƙara girma. A Kallo, canza zuwa launi bisa matsi (emitters da ke wajen taga a ja/shunayya) ko nuna diamita.
tutorial.In View, choose Colour by pressure: A Kallo, zaɓi Launi bisa matsi

tutorial.View → Interface changes the size of the: Kallo → Fuskar manhaja yana canza girman dukan fuskar manhaja ba tare da taɓa zuƙowar mai binciken gizo ba, yana kunna bambancin launi mai ƙarfi (rubutu da gefuna masu ƙarfi, a jigon duhu da na haske), yana ninke allon gefe kuma yana shiga yanayin mai da hankali (Ctrl+Alt+F), wanda ke ɓoye menus, faifan kayan aiki da alluna ya bar allon zane kaɗai; Ctrl+K yana ci gaba da aiki a cikinsa. Ana riƙe faɗin allon gefe da tsayin rahotanni.
tutorial.The AI assistant is optional and works o: Mataimakin AI na zaɓi ne kuma yana aiki a kan aikin da ke buɗe da kayan aiki iri ɗaya da na menus: yana tsara masu fesa ruwa da ɗigo, yana shimfiɗa bututu, yana auna girma, yana gyara gargaɗi kuma yana rubuta rahoto. Buɗe shi da Ƙira → Mataimakin AI, umarnin AI, maɓallin mutum-mutumi (robot) a mashayar matsayi ko adireshin ?ai=1; allon yana zama kusa da zane (a ƙasa a waya). Ba a aika komai kafin ka danna Aika: “Nuna mini” yana buɗe allon tare da misalin buƙata da aka rubuta a ciki, ba tare da aika shi ba.
tutorial.Open the assistant with Design → AI assi: Buɗe mataimakin da Ƙira → Mataimakin AI
tutorial.Tap the robot button at the top of the s: Taɓa maɓallin mutum-mutumi a saman allo
tutorial.Lay out the lawn sprinklers and size the: Tsara masu fesa ruwa na ciyawa ka auna yankunan.
tutorial.Write what you want in your own words, f: Rubuta abin da kake so da kalmominka, misali “tsara masu fesa ruwa na ciyawa ka auna yankunan”. Yana nuna shirinsa kuma yana neman amincewa ga kowane canji (Aiwatar ko Tsallake); za ka iya rubutu yayin da yake aiki ka kuma tsayar da shi a kowane lokaci. Ana warware kowace amsa da dannawa ɗaya, kuma kowane saƙo yana da Koma nan. Samfuri na iya yin kuskure: duba aikinsa kamar yadda za ka duba na abokin aiki.
tutorial.Why is the pressure of this zone low? Fi: Me ya sa matsin wannan yankin ya yi ƙasa? Gyara shi ba tare da canza famfo ba.
tutorial./review reviews the whole design without: /review yana bitar dukan ƙirar ba tare da canza komai ba kuma yana amsawa da jerin dubawa. Yi alamar wuri da Yi alamar layi suna nuna wa mataimakin inda kake son wani abu a zane; makirufo yana rubuta saƙon da baki; fayiloli, zane, takardun bayanai na PDF da hotunan gona masu GPS ana iya haɗa su, manna su ko saki su a kan allon. Tattaunawa suna zama a wannan mai binciken gizo (24 mafi kwanan nan) kuma ba sa taɓa shiga fayil ɗin aikin.
tutorial.Examples, recent projects and welcome: Misalai, ayyukan kwanan nan da barka da zuwa
tutorial.Besides the default layers, create your: Baya ga layers na asali, ƙirƙiri naka da “Sabon layer” a ƙasan shafin Layers: ba shi suna da launi. Danna sau biyu yana canza suna, ɗigon yana nuna layer na yanzu (inda sababbin layuka, rubutu da alamomi ke shiga), murabba'in launi yana canza launi, kuma Goge yana mayar da abubuwansa zuwa DRAWING. Layers suna zama layers na DXF/DWG da bayanin takardar PDF.
tutorial.Also in Design → Parameters: sizing meth: Har ila yau a Ƙira → Sigogi: hanyar auna girma (shirye-shiryen layi, wanda ke auna kuɗin bututu, makamashi da yanayin ƙasa, ko greedy ta gudu → tagar matsi → tattalin arziki); iyakar adadin girma ga kowane lateral, submain da babban bututu (telescoping); emitters ga kowace shuka (EU) da iyakar bambancin matsi na yanki; gudun wankewa da mafi ƙarancin matsi a ƙarshen tef; duba bugun ruwa da lokacin rufe bawul da ajin bututu; zaɓin haɗi ta atomatik da tsawon sandar bututu (couplers); ƙara yawan DEM da haƙurin haɗi.
tutorial.The Bill of materials tab groups pipes (: Shafin Jerin kayan aiki yana haɗa bututu (bisa girma da aji), tef, emitters, bawuloli, na'urori, famfuna kuma, idan zaɓi ta atomatik yana kunne, haɗi: couplers ga kowace sanda, gwiwoyi, tees, masu rage girma, murfin ƙarshe, mafitar lateral da risers. Yana nuna yawa, kuɗin kowane ɗaya daga kasida, jimillar kowane rukuni da kuɗin shekara (jarin da aka raba shekara + makamashi). Ana fitar da shi a CSV, TXT, XLSX ko PDF ta Fayil → Fitar da rahoto, kuma takardar PDF na iya ɗaukar jerin.
tutorial.In the pivot properties choose the sprin: A kaddarorin pivot zaɓi mai fesa ruwa da mai daidaita matsi daga kasida, tazarar masu fesa ruwa da kuɗin kowane hasumiya. Shafin Pivots yana taƙaita kowace na'ura (hasumiyoyi, fili, matsin da ake buƙata da wanda ke akwai, zurfi da awoyi a kowane zagaye, mafi girman ƙimar ban ruwa); shafin Tsawon pivot yana bayyana kowane tsawo: radius na farko da na ƙarshe, adadin masu fesa ruwa, kwarara ga kowane mai fesa ruwa, matsi a tsawon da bakin da aka ba da shawara. Hasumiyoyi, masu fesa ruwa da bindigar ƙarshe suna shiga jerin kayan aiki.
tutorial.The Design menu splits the cycle: Size z: Menu na Ƙira yana raba zagayen: Auna yankuna yana lissafa laterals da submains kawai; Auna babban bututu babban bututu da tushen ruwa kawai; Bincika (girman da ke akwai) ba ya canza kowane diamita, yana lissafa kwarara da matsi da bututun kamar yadda aka zana, ya dace don duba shigarwar da ke akwai ko zaɓinka; Share sakamako yana cire sakamako da lakabi. Duk wani gyara a hanyar sadarwa yana soke sakamakon har sai lissafi na gaba.
tutorial.Sizing in parts and analysing: Auna girma a sassa da bincike
tutorial.Marking minimum and maximum pressure: Yin alama matsi ƙarami da babba
tutorial.Junction (J): a node that joins pipes. T: Mahaɗi (J): wuri ne da ke haɗa bututu. Bututu biyu da suka haye juna ba tare da mahaɗi ba ba a haɗa su ba (Duba ƙira yana gargaɗi): saka mahaɗi a wurin hayewa, sai a raba bututun a haɗa su a nan. Yana kuma amfani wajen reshe bututu a tsakiya ko tabbatar da tsayin wuri. Menu na Babban bututu yana da sigar babban bututu.
tutorial.With the project georeferenced (File → G: Idan aikin yana da matsayin wuri (Fayil → Matsayin wuri, ta latitude/longitude ko UTM), Kallo → Taswirar tushe yana sa taswira a ƙarƙashin zane: OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, CARTO da Esri (tituna, yanayin ƙasa, tauraron ɗan adam) ba tare da maɓalli ba; Google Maps (taswirar hanya, tauraron ɗan adam, gauraye, yanayin ƙasa) da maɓallin Map Tiles API naka; ko URL na XYZ na musamman daga sabar ka. Za a iya sanya hoton da aka shigo da shi ta Fayil → Saita matsayin wurin hoton da aka zaɓa (kusurwa, girma da juyawa) ko ta Daidaita da wurare 2; GeoTIFF da fayilolin world suna sauka a wurin da ya dace da kansu.
tutorial.Pivot spans and sprinklers: Tsawon pivot da masu fesa ruwa
tutorial.Base maps and georeferenced images: Taswirorin tushe da hotuna masu matsayin wuri
tutorial.In Design, choose Analyse (existing size: A Ƙira, zaɓi Bincika (girman da ke akwai)
tutorial.Type J and click on a zone pipe: Rubuta J sannan ka danna kan bututun yanki
tutorial.Mainline/duty: for each system flow, the: Babban bututu / wurin aiki: ga kowane zangon aiki, kwarara da matsin da ake buƙata a tushen ruwa, matsin da ke akwai, tsayin famfo, makamashi a shekara da matsayi (ok ko gazawa). Emitters: kowane emitter da kwararar da matsin da aka lissafa. Buƙatun ruwa: ga kowane fili, zurfin gaba ɗaya, yawa da awoyi a rana. Wankewa: gudu a ƙarshen kowane tef/lateral idan aka kwatanta da gudun da ake so. Bugun ruwa: gudun igiyar ruwa, ƙarin matsi da jimillar matsi na kowane bututu idan aka kwatanta da ajinsa (PN).
tutorial.In Design → Catalog, \"Manufacturer cata: A Ƙira → Kasida, “Kasidun masana'antu…” yana lissafa fakitin kayayyaki masu wakilci (bututu, emitters, tef, bawuloli, famfuna): waɗanda ke tare da manhajar da waɗanda aka ɗora yanzu. Ƙara fakiti a aikin, shigo da fayil .oci.cat ko ɗora shi daga URL (fakiti ko index.json). Kasidar tana kuma shigo da JSON, CSV ko Excel, tana fitar da Excel/CSV/JSON, kuma tana fitar da kasidarka a matsayin fakiti don rabawa. “Yi amfani a matsayin tsoho ga sabbin ayyuka” yana riƙe kasidar farko ta ayyuka na gaba, “Loda tsoho nawa” da “Manta tsoho nawa” suna dawo da ita ko su share ta, kuma “Maido da kasidar masana'anta” yana sa kasidar shirin a wannan aiki (kowanne yana tambaya tukuna).
tutorial.Select an irrigated area: besides net de: Zaɓi fili da ake ban ruwa: baya ga zurfin tsantsa da inganci, sashen Ma'aunin ruwa na kaddarori yana ɗaukar amfanin gona (Kc da aka shirya daga FAO-56), ETo, ruwan da ke cikin ƙasa, zurfin saiwa, raguwar da aka yarda (MAD), kason da aka jiƙa da tazarar shuke-shuke da layuka. Shafin Ilimin noma yana lissafa ETc, zurfin tsantsa da na gaba ɗaya ga kowane ban ruwa, tazarar tsakanin ban ruwa da awoyi ga kowane ban ruwa da emitters da ke cikin filin, tare da CU na haɗuwa.
tutorial.Symbol (SY): inserts a vector symbol in: Alama (SY): tana saka alamar vector a cikin zane: kibiyar arewa, itace, gini, tanki, rijiya, akwatin bawul, ɗakin famfo, ƙofa ko tashar tace ruwa; iri, girma da juyawa suna cikin kaddarori. Layin nuni (LE): danna kan kibiya da kusurwoyi, Enter yana buɗe rubutun bayani. Dukansu suna shiga DXF/DWG da takardar PDF.
tutorial.The map and the terrain need to know whe: Taswira da ƙasa suna buƙatar sanin inda gonar take. Fayil → Matsayin wuri (georeference) yana haɗa asalin zane (0, 0) da latitude da longitude (ko da haɗin kai na UTM). A Google Maps, danna dama a kan gonar ka kwafi haɗin kanta: haɗin da aka liƙa a filin Latitude (misali -21.4459, -45.4592), mahaɗin Google Maps ko digiri, mintuna da daƙiƙoƙi ma suna aiki.
tutorial.Open File → Georeference, enter the site: Buɗe Fayil → Matsayin wuri (georeference), shigar da latitude da longitude na gonar sannan ka danna To
tutorial.Satellite map under the drawing: Taswirar tauraron ɗan adam ƙarƙashin zane
tutorial.View → Base map → Satellite (Esri World: Kallo → Taswirar tushe → Tauraron ɗan adam (Esri World Imagery) yana nuna hoton gonar ƙarƙashin zanen, ba tare da maɓalli ko rajista ba; ka zuƙo da ƙafafun linzamin kwamfuta don ganin layukan shuka. Menu ɗin nan ma yana da taswirorin hanyoyi da na yanayin ƙasa (OpenStreetMap, Esri) da Google Maps tare da maɓallin Map Tiles API naka. Hoton yana bayyana ne kawai idan an saita matsayin wuri.
tutorial.Choose View → Base map → Satellite: Zaɓi Kallo → Taswirar tushe → Tauraron ɗan adam
tutorial.Design → Terrain → Download elevation fr: Ƙira → Ƙasa → Sauke tsayi daga intanet (DEM) yana ƙirƙirar raga na wuraren tsayi a kan gonar daga samfurin tsayi na dijital na jama'a; tushen Terrain Tiles (SRTM 30 m) yana da sauri kuma ba ya buƙatar rajista. Ka bar zaɓuɓɓukan maye gurbin tsayin da ake da su (na misalin suna a 100 m, nesa da ainihin tsayi) da na samar da layukan tsayi a kunne: layukan suna bayyana a kan hoton tauraron ɗan adam, kuma kowane bututu da kowane emitter yana samun ainihin tsayinsa a lissafin matsi. Ƙira → Ƙasa → Kallon ƙasa na 3D yana nuna yanayin ƙasa.
tutorial.Open Design → Terrain → Download elevati: Buɗe Ƙira → Ƙasa → Sauke tsayi daga intanet (DEM) sannan ka danna Sauke
tutorial.Design → System flows defines which valv: Ƙira → Zangunan aiki yana ƙayyade waɗanne bawuloli (da pivot) ke buɗewa tare da tsawon lokaci. Kowane zango yanayin nauyi ne ga babban bututu; ana auna tushe ga mafi muni. "Duka tare" da "Ɗaya bayan ɗaya" suna cika tebur; "Kai tsaye…" yana haɗa yankuna cikin mafi ƙarancin zanguna da suka dace da kwararar tushe (ko kwarara da adadin yankuna da ka zaɓa).
tutorial.Densogram: the water every spot receives: Densogram: ruwan da kowane wuri ke samu
tutorial.Zone → Densogram (DENS) adds up the wett: Yanki → Densogram (DENS) yana haɗa da'irar da kowane mai yayyafi da ƙaramin mai yayyafi ke jiƙawa kamar yadda aka zana — wuri, baka, fuskanta kuma, bayan lissafi, matsin kowanne — sannan ya zana yawan ruwa: ja inda ruwa ya yi ƙaranci, kore a matsakaici, shuɗi da shunayya inda ya yi yawa. Taga yana nuna CU, DU, ma'aunin tsarin lokaci da wurare masu bushewa a cikin wuraren ban ruwa, tare da yanayin rarraba mai yayyafi da girman sel; ana iya fitar da grid a CSV.
tutorial.Open Zone → Densogram and click Show on: Buɗe Yanki → Densogram kuma danna Nuna a zanen
tutorial.Zone → Controller (CTRL) places the cont: Yanki → Mai sarrafawa (CTRL) yana ajiye mai sarrafawa; Yanki → Hanyar wayoyi (WR) yana zana hanyar wayoyi daga gare shi zuwa bawuloli (ku ratsa daidai ta kansu). A lissafi kowace bawul tana samun tasha da wayarta, duka suna raba wayar gama gari, kuma ana zaɓar kauri mafi arha domin solenoid ya sami aƙalla mafi ƙarancin voltage lokacin buɗewa, yayin da bawulolin zango ɗaya ke kunne. Shafin Lantarki yana lissafa tashoshi, tsawo, kauri da voltage; wayoyi, mai sarrafawa da mahaɗai suna shiga jerin kayan aiki.
tutorial.Type CTRL and click near the valves: Rubuta CTRL kuma danna kusa da bawuloli
tutorial.In the assistant's settings, choose the: A saitunan mataimakin, zaɓi kamfanin da samfurin — Claude (Anthropic), GPT (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), Grok (xAI), Muse (Meta) ko ɗaya daga cikin samfuran OpenRouter — ka manna maɓallin API naka: yana zama a ƙwaƙwalwa kawai, sai dai idan ka yi alama a Tuna maɓallin a wannan na'ura, kuma kowace buƙata tana tafiya kai tsaye daga mai binciken gizo zuwa mai bayarwa, wanda ke caji asusunka. Yanayin yana faɗin abin da zai iya yi: karatu kawai, tsari da farko, tambaya kafin kowane canji (na tsoho) ko aiwatar da canje-canje ta atomatik; iyakar matakai da iyakar kashe kuɗi suna ƙare dogon aiki.
